title: Capacitated Spatiotemporal Matching
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Capacitated Spatiotemporal Matching

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rotman School of Management Working Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study a spatiotemporal service matching problem in which demand, heterogeneous in location and time sensitivity/preference, is to be assigned to service stations. The planner seeks to maximize social welfare, defined as total service reward minus spatial and temporal costs, by optimally scheduling demand to stations and service time under processing capacity constraints. We formulate the problem as an optimal transport (OT) model that allows for both demand-capacity imbalance and endogenously unserved demand when service costs exceed rewards. Leveraging a barycenter-style decomposition, we reformulate the problem as a finite-dimensional convex optimization problem that generalizes semi-discrete OT and enables scalable computation. We characterize the geometry of optimal assignments, showing that spatial partitions correspond to generalized Laguerre cells. Temporally, we show that the structure of the optimal schedule depends on demand heterogeneity: when demand differs only in temporal cost sensitivity, higher-sensitivity demand is assigned service times closer to the common ideal time; when demand differs only in preferred times, the assignment is order-preserving with respect to preferred times. We further propose an envy-free, individually rational implementation of the optimal schedule using time-dependent pricing and a finite-slot mechanism with explicit bounds depending on the number of required slots. To illustrate the framework, we extend the classic Hotelling linear-city model on a line segment by incorporating a continuum of waiting-cost sensitivities, demonstrating how optimal spatial partitions vary with changes in sensitivity heterogeneity and reward. Finally, we conduct a numerical study of a vaccination-planning problem using publicly available 2021 data from the City of Toronto. The results show that joint spatiotemporal matching reduces total social cost by at least 3.24% relative to other policies that separate location assignment and scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了时空服务匹配问题，通过最优运输模型最大化社会福利，考虑需求在位置和时间敏感性/偏好上的异质性。提出了可扩展的计算方法，分析了最优分配的空间几何结构（广义Laguerre单元）和时间调度结构，并设计了无嫉妒、个体理性的实施机制。通过疫苗接种规划案例验证了联合时空匹配相比分离策略可降低至少3.24%的社会总成本。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑需求位置和时间敏感性/偏好异质性的情况下，通过最优调度需求到服务站和服务时间，在容量约束下最大化社会福利？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的服务匹配问题（如疫苗接种、共享出行）需要考虑需求在空间位置和时间偏好上的异质性，同时面临服务容量约束。现有研究往往将空间分配和时间调度分离处理，未能充分捕捉时空联合优化的潜在效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优运输理论、广义Laguerre单元几何结构、半离散最优运输、凸优化理论、机制设计理论（无嫉妒、个体理性）
AI.method: 1. 建立最优运输模型处理需求-容量不平衡和内生未服务需求；2. 采用重心式分解将问题转化为有限维凸优化问题；3. 理论分析最优分配的空间几何结构（广义Laguerre单元）和时间调度结构；4. 设计基于时间依赖定价和有限槽位机制的实施方案；5. 扩展Hotelling线性城市模型进行理论说明；6. 使用多伦多市2021年公开数据进行疫苗接种规划数值研究。
AI.findings: 1. 空间上最优分配对应广义Laguerre单元；2. 时间调度结构取决于需求异质性：仅时间成本敏感性不同时，高敏感性需求被分配到更接近共同理想时间的服务时间；仅偏好时间不同时，分配保持与偏好时间的顺序一致性；3. 联合时空匹配相比分离策略可降低至少3.24%的社会总成本；4. 提出的实施机制可实现无嫉妒和个体理性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将最优运输理论扩展到时空服务匹配问题；2. 揭示了最优分配的空间几何结构（广义Laguerre单元）；3. 刻画了需求异质性如何影响时间调度结构；4. 提出了可扩展的计算方法；5. 设计了理论保证的实施机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为疫苗接种、共享出行等实际服务匹配问题提供了优化框架；2. 提出的算法具有可扩展性，适用于大规模实际问题；3. 实施机制设计考虑了现实可行性；4. 通过多伦多疫苗接种案例验证了实际效益；5. 为政策制定者提供了联合时空优化的决策支持。

title: Getting Priorities Straight: A Cluster Typology of Nurses’ Implementation Perspectives on Sensor-Based Technologies
affiliations: Paracelsus Medical University Salzburg and Paracelsus Medical University Salzburg

detail.title: Getting Priorities Straight: A Cluster Typology of Nurses’ Implementation Perspectives on Sensor-Based Technologies
detail.abstract:
Background. Sensor-based digital technologies are increasingly implemented in long-term geriatric care to support nursing workflows, enhance patient safety, and enable real-time monitoring. However, implementation outcomes remain inconsistent, suggesting that nurses’ perceptions of such technologies are heterogeneous and not adequately captured by mean-based acceptance measures.
Aims. This study aimed to identify empirically derived implementation perception profiles of sensor-based digital nursing technologies among geriatric nurses working in long-term care settings.
Methods. An exploratory cross-sectional survey was conducted among nursing professionals in long-term geriatric care (n = 43). Implementation perceptions were assessed using binary indicators reflecting functional, efficiency-related, safety, and governance-related aspects of sensor-based technologies. Hierarchical cluster analysis with Jaccard distance and complete linkage was applied to identify distinct implementation perception profiles. Cluster robustness and quality were assessed using silhouette coefficients and bootstrapping procedures.
Results. A four-cluster solution was identified, representing distinct implementation perception profiles. Rather than differing along a single acceptance continuum, clusters were characterized by different configurations of perceived system functionality, efficiency implications, safety considerations, and governance-related concerns. The results demonstrate substantial heterogeneity in how geriatric nurses evaluate sensor-based digital nursing technologies.
Conclusion. Implementation perceptions of sensor-based digital nursing technologies among geriatric nurses are heterogeneous and structured into distinct profiles that cannot be captured by mean acceptance scores alone. A profile-oriented, cluster-analytic approach provides actionable insights for the design and implementation of sensor-based digital nursing technologies in long-term care by supporting more targeted and context-sensitive implementation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过聚类分析识别了老年护理护士对传感器数字护理技术的四种不同实施感知特征，超越了简单的平均接受度测量，揭示了护士群体内部的异质性认知模式。
AI.research_question: 老年护理护士对传感器数字护理技术的实施感知存在哪些不同的特征模式？
AI.motivation: 传感器数字技术在老年长期护理中的应用日益增多，但实施效果不一致，表明护士对这些技术的感知存在异质性，而传统的平均接受度测量无法充分捕捉这种多样性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型、实施科学、聚类分析理论，关注功能、效率、安全和治理四个维度的技术感知。
AI.method: 采用探索性横断面调查，对43名长期老年护理护士进行问卷调查，使用二元指标评估功能、效率、安全和治理相关方面的实施感知，应用Jaccard距离和完全连接的层次聚类分析识别不同感知特征，通过轮廓系数和自助法评估聚类稳健性和质量。
AI.findings: 识别出四种不同的实施感知特征，这些特征不是沿着单一的接受度连续体分布，而是由系统功能、效率影响、安全考虑和治理相关担忧的不同配置所表征，表明老年护理护士对传感器数字护理技术的评估存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 超越了传统的平均接受度测量方法，提出了基于特征模式的异质性分析框架，为技术接受和实施科学领域提供了新的分析视角，强调多维度的技术感知配置而非单一维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为传感器数字护理技术的设计和实施提供可操作的见解，支持更精准、情境敏感的实施策略，帮助管理者识别不同护士群体的特定需求和担忧，制定差异化的干预措施。

title: Sustainability Consciousness and Non-government Organisational Performance in Bangladesh
affiliations: Ton Duc Thang University and Central Queensland University (CQUniversity)

detail.title: Sustainability Consciousness and Non-government Organisational Performance in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Bangladesh's Gen-Z battle with the government to improve youth employment prospects and eliminate corruption are two cornerstone issues sustainable development addresses. Non-Governmental Organisation (NGO) firms play a crucial role in contributing to sustainable development by addressing these issues. This study examined NGO managers' perceived awareness of the role of sustainability capital in their organisational performance. It administered a 5-point Likert-scale questionnaire that inquired into managers' perceptions of intellectual capital (knowledge), social capital (structural, relational, and cognitive dimensions), and environmental capital in driving sustainability capital, and sustainability capital driving organisational performance. Structural equation modelling analysed data from 113 respondent NGO firms. Social capital, environmental capital, and intellectual capital positively influenced sustainability capital. Sustainability capital positively influenced NGO performance. The political economy, institutional, and incomplete contracts theories informed the results. The findings have implications for NGO managers becoming sustainability-conscious within organisational, funder, and governmental deliberations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨孟加拉国NGO管理者对可持续资本在组织绩效中作用的认知，发现社会资本、环境资本和智力资本正向影响可持续资本，而可持续资本又正向影响NGO绩效。
AI.research_question: NGO管理者如何认知可持续资本在其组织绩效中的作用？社会资本、环境资本和智力资本如何影响可持续资本？可持续资本又如何影响NGO绩效？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国Z世代与政府斗争改善青年就业前景和消除腐败是可持续发展的两个核心问题，NGO组织在解决这些问题中扮演关键角色。需要了解NGO管理者对可持续资本作用的认知，以促进可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学理论、制度理论、不完全契约理论。研究框架包括智力资本（知识）、社会资本（结构、关系、认知维度）、环境资本作为可持续资本的前因变量，可持续资本作为组织绩效的驱动因素。
AI.method: 采用5点李克特量表问卷调查113家NGO组织的管理者，使用结构方程模型分析数据，测量管理者对智力资本、社会资本、环境资本、可持续资本和组织绩效的感知。
AI.findings: 社会资本、环境资本和智力资本对可持续资本有正向影响；可持续资本对NGO绩效有正向影响。所有假设关系均得到支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了可持续资本理论在NGO背景下的应用；整合了政治经济学、制度和不完全契约理论来解释NGO可持续资本的形成机制；为可持续资本的前因和后果提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助NGO管理者在组织决策、资助方沟通和政府协商中增强可持续意识；为NGO组织如何通过投资社会、环境和智力资本来提升可持续绩效提供实践指导；为政策制定者支持NGO可持续发展提供依据。

title: Regulated Leadership: A Process Model of Behavioral Integrity Under Environmental Threat

detail.title: Regulated Leadership: A Process Model of Behavioral Integrity Under Environmental Threat
detail.abstract: Leadership research has identified effective leadership principles and behaviors, yet leaders frequently fail to enact them under environmental threat, undermining behavioral integrity. Existing models largely assume that knowledge and intention are sufficient for consistent execution, leaving the mechanism of behavioral alignment under environmental threat insufficiently specified. This paper introduces Regulated Leadership, a process model proposing that regulatory capacity across emotional, cognitive, and behavioral domains moderates the relationship between leadership principles and behavioral execution. Integrating leadership theory, emotion regulation research, and clinical models of regulatory capacity, the framework conceptualizes behavioral integrity as a capacity-dependent outcome under environmental threat. Psychological activation, elicited by environmental threat, disrupts regulatory capacity, initiating threat-activated protection patterns that produce predictable distortions of stated principles. This model specifies a moderated mediation process in which the indirect effect of psychological activation on behavioral integrity, through threat-activated protection patterns, is conditional on regulatory capacity. The framework further introduces a theoretically derived taxonomy of these patterns and identifies regulatory capacity as the moderating mechanism through which leaders maintain or lose behavioral integrity under environmental threat. By shifting the level of analysis from values, traits, and competencies to regulatory processes, this framework offers a process-based account of leadership behavior and provides a foundation for more precise theorizing, measurement, and intervention in high-demand organizational environments. Behavioral integrity under environmental threat is not a reflection of character or intention; rather, it is a regulatory achievement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"调节型领导力"模型，认为在环境威胁下，领导者的行为一致性取决于其跨情绪、认知和行为领域的调节能力，而非单纯的知识或意图。
AI.research_question: 在环境威胁下，领导者为何难以执行已知的有效领导原则和行为？调节能力如何影响领导者在威胁下的行为一致性？
AI.motivation: 现有领导力研究假设知识和意图足以确保行为一致性，但现实中领导者在环境威胁下经常无法执行已知的有效领导原则，导致行为完整性受损。需要解释这一现象的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合领导力理论、情绪调节研究和临床调节能力模型，提出"调节型领导力"框架，将行为完整性概念化为环境威胁下依赖调节能力的结果。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，提出调节中介过程模型：心理激活通过威胁激活保护模式影响行为完整性的间接效应，受到调节能力的调节。
AI.findings: 1) 环境威胁引发的心理激活会破坏调节能力；2) 启动威胁激活保护模式，导致对既定原则的可预测扭曲；3) 调节能力是领导者在环境威胁下维持或失去行为完整性的调节机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 从价值观、特质和能力转向调节过程的分析层次转变；2) 提出威胁激活保护模式的理论分类；3) 为高需求组织环境提供更精确的理论化、测量和干预基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 认识到环境威胁下的行为完整性不是性格或意图的反映，而是调节成就；2) 为组织提供基于调节过程的领导力发展和干预方法；3) 帮助领导者更好地应对高压力环境。

title: Vocational Guidance in Maritime Careers

detail.title: Vocational Guidance in Maritime Careers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: THE AUTHOR DECLARES NO CONFLICT OF INTEREST RELATED TO THIS RESEARCH.
declarations.ethicsApproval: THIS RESEARCH DOES NOT INVOLVE HUMAN PARTICIPANTS, PERSSONAL DATA, OR EXPERIMENTAL PROCEDURES REQUIRING ETHICS APPROVAL
declarations.funderStatement: THIS RESEARCH RECEIVED NO EXTERNAL FUNDING AND WAS INDEPENDENTLY DEVELOPED BY THE AUTOR

detail.abstract: Vocational guidance plays a decisive role in the development of human capital in strategic industries such as the maritime sector. Because maritime operations sustain global trade, energy transportation, and international supply chains, the industry requires professionals who possess discipline, technical preparation, and a strong sense of responsibility. However, many young people enter professional training without fully understanding the realities of maritime life. This situation frequently results in academic abandonment, professional dissatisfaction, or inefficient workforce development. This article explores the role of vocational guidance in maritime career formation. It analyzes how early orientation, discipline-based preparation, and structured educational models can improve long-term professional alignment and contribute to workforce sustainability in the maritime sector. Drawing from educational experiences developed since 1998 through maritime educational initiatives, this study highlights the importance of integrating orientation, education, and character formation in preparing future maritime professionals.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨职业指导在海事职业形成中的作用，分析早期定向、学科准备和结构化教育模式如何改善长期职业匹配度，促进海事行业劳动力可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 职业指导在海事职业形成中扮演什么角色？早期定向、学科准备和结构化教育模式如何改善长期职业匹配度并促进海事行业劳动力可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 海事行业作为支撑全球贸易、能源运输和国际供应链的战略产业，需要具备纪律性、技术准备和强烈责任感的专业人员。然而，许多年轻人进入专业培训时并不完全了解海事生活的现实，导致学业放弃、职业不满或劳动力发展效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业指导理论、人力资源发展理论、教育心理学理论、海事职业教育理论
AI.method: 基于1998年以来海事教育倡议的教育经验分析，采用案例研究和经验总结的方法
AI.findings: 整合定向、教育和品格培养对于培养未来海事专业人员至关重要。早期职业指导、学科准备和结构化教育模式能够显著提高职业匹配度，减少学业放弃率，增强职业满意度，促进海事行业劳动力的可持续发展。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 拓展了职业指导理论在海事领域的应用
2. 提出了海事职业形成的整合模型
3. 发展了战略产业人力资源发展的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为海事教育机构提供职业指导实践指南
2. 帮助减少海事专业学生的学业放弃率
3. 提高海事行业劳动力匹配度和满意度
4. 促进海事行业可持续发展的人才培养策略

title: Algorithmic Intimacy vs Data Anxiety: Examining the Dual Impact of AI-Driven Personalization on Consumer Trust and Brand Equity.

detail.title: Algorithmic Intimacy vs Data Anxiety: Examining the Dual Impact of AI-Driven Personalization on Consumer Trust and Brand Equity.
detail.abstract: In the modern digital era, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has significantly transformed marketing strategies and consumer interactions. AI-driven personalization, often referred to as "algorithmic intimacy," enables organizations to predict and respond to consumer needs with remarkable accuracy (Kotler, 2020). However, this advancement also creates concerns regarding privacy, leading to "data anxiety," where consumers feel uncertain and uncomfortable about how their data is collected, stored, and used (Zuboff, 2019). This study examines the dual impact of AI-driven personalization on consumer trust and brand equity. Using a quantitative research design, primary data was collected from 120 respondents through a structured questionnaire. The findings indicate that while personalization enhances trust and improves user experience, data anxiety negatively influences consumer confidence. The study emphasizes the need for balancing technological innovation with ethical data practices.

AI.tldr: AI驱动的个性化营销通过"算法亲密性"提升用户体验和信任，但"数据焦虑"会削弱消费者信心，需要在技术创新与道德数据实践间取得平衡。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的个性化如何同时影响消费者信任和品牌资产？
AI.motivation: AI技术显著改变了营销策略和消费者互动，但算法亲密性带来的数据收集和使用引发了消费者的隐私担忧和数据焦虑，需要研究这种双重影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法亲密性理论（Kotler, 2020）和数据焦虑概念（Zuboff, 2019）
AI.method: 定量研究设计，通过结构化问卷收集120名受访者的主要数据
AI.findings: 个性化增强信任并改善用户体验，但数据焦虑对消费者信心产生负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对AI个性化双重影响的理解，整合了算法亲密性和数据焦虑的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 强调企业需要在技术创新和道德数据实践之间取得平衡，以维持消费者信任和品牌资产

title: Job market signaling and inequality in the age of generative AI
affiliations: Bielefeld University - Center for Mathematical Economics and Leibniz Universität Hannover - Faculty of Economics and Management

detail.title: Job market signaling and inequality in the age of generative AI
detail.abstract: We introduce technological change into a Spence-type job market signaling model. Privately informed workers can signal their type to firms by acquiring an observable level of education, with higher-productivity workers facing lower marginal costs of education. In line with recent empirical evidence on the effects of generative artificial intelligence (AI), we assume that a higher level of AI widens the productivity gap between high and medium types, while narrowing the gap between medium and low types. We first show that there is a unique equilibrium that satisfies the D1 criterion. Second, in our main result, we show that increasing the level of AI increases the education level of high types but decreases that of medium types. Thus, AI increases education inequality between high-productivity types and the other groups.

AI.tldr: 该研究将技术变革引入Spence型劳动力市场信号模型，分析生成式AI如何影响教育信号和生产率差距。研究发现AI会扩大高生产率与中等生产率工人之间的教育不平等。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何影响劳动力市场中的教育信号均衡？具体来说，AI技术变革如何改变不同生产率类型工人的教育投资决策？
AI.motivation: 近年来生成式AI对劳动力市场产生显著影响，实证证据表明AI会扩大高生产率与中等生产率工人之间的生产率差距，同时缩小中等与低生产率工人之间的差距。需要理论模型来理解这种技术变革如何影响教育信号机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Spence的劳动力市场信号理论，构建包含三种生产率类型（高、中、低）的信号模型，其中高生产率工人的教育边际成本较低。引入AI技术作为外生变量，影响不同类型工人的相对生产率差距。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建博弈论信号模型，分析满足D1准则的独特均衡。通过比较静态分析，研究AI水平变化对均衡教育水平的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 存在满足D1准则的唯一均衡；2. AI水平提高会增加高生产率类型工人的教育水平，但降低中等生产率类型工人的教育水平；3. AI加剧了高生产率工人与其他群体之间的教育不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术变革（特别是AI）纳入经典信号理论框架，为理解AI如何重塑教育信号机制提供理论解释。扩展了Spence模型的应用范围，为AI时代的教育投资决策提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：AI技术发展可能加剧教育不平等，需要相应政策干预。帮助企业和教育机构理解AI时代的教育信号价值变化，指导人力资源管理和教育投资决策。

title: The Green-Trust Framework: Evaluating the Synergy of AI and Blockchain in Enhancing Consumer Trust for Sustainability Marketing.

detail.title: The Green-Trust Framework: Evaluating the Synergy of AI and Blockchain in Enhancing Consumer Trust for Sustainability Marketing.
detail.abstract: In today's rapidly evolving market, sustainability has become a critical factor influencing consumer purchasing decisions. Consumers demand transparency and ethical behavior from brands, yet greenwashing and misleading claims continue to undermine trust. Emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Blockchain offer unique solutions to enhance consumer confidence in sustainable practices. This paper introduces the Green-Trust Framework, a conceptual model that combines AI and Blockchain to strengthen consumer trust in sustainability marketing. The framework leverages AI for data analysis, verification of claims, and personalized communication, while Blockchain provides transparency and immutability in supply chains. Through conceptual exploration and real-world application scenarios, this research highlights how the synergy of these technologies can build a trustworthy, ethical, and consumer-centric sustainability ecosystem. Finally, the paper discusses the benefits, limitations, and future research directions to guide marketers, regulators, and organizations in adopting technology-driven trust mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合人工智能和区块链的"绿色信任框架"，旨在解决可持续发展营销中的信任问题，通过技术手段增强消费者对可持续实践的信任。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能和区块链技术增强消费者对可持续发展营销的信任？
AI.motivation: 当前市场绿色清洗和误导性声明普遍，消费者对可持续性声明缺乏信任，而AI和区块链技术为解决这一问题提供了新的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色信任框架（Green-Trust Framework）——一个结合AI和区块链的概念模型，AI负责数据分析、声明验证和个性化沟通，区块链提供供应链透明度和不可篡改性。
AI.method: 概念性探索和现实应用场景分析，通过理论框架构建和技术整合研究。
AI.findings: AI和区块链的协同作用可以建立一个可信、道德和以消费者为中心的可持续发展生态系统，增强消费者信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了绿色信任框架这一创新概念模型，为可持续发展营销中的信任建立提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员、监管机构和组织提供了技术驱动的信任机制实施指南，包括框架应用、限制分析和未来研究方向。

title: Impact of Covid-19 on Consumer Buying Behaviour: A Study Among Employed Consumers in Malappuram District

detail.title: Impact of Covid-19 on Consumer Buying Behaviour: A Study Among Employed Consumers in Malappuram District

declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The global spread of COVID-19 created unprecedented disruptions in economic activities and daily life, leading to significant changes in consumer purchasing behaviour. This study examines how the pandemic influenced the buying behaviour of consumers, with special reference to employed individuals in Malappuram district. The research aims to identify the major factors that affected purchasing decisions during the pandemic, analyze the changes in consumption patterns of household goods compared to the period before the pandemic, and understand the difficulties experienced by consumers while purchasing essential items.The study is descriptive in nature and is based on both primary and secondary sources of data. Primary data were collected from 160 respondents through a structured questionnaire using convenience sampling. Various statistical tools such as mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, and non-parametric tests were used to analyze the collected data.The results indicate that the pandemic significantly influenced consumer priorities and purchasing behaviour. Consumers increased their spending on essential and hygiene-related products while reducing purchases of non-essential goods. Lockdown restrictions, health concerns, supply shortages, and income uncertainty were found to be major factors affecting consumer decisions. The study highlights that crisis situations such as pandemics can reshape consumption patterns and accelerate shifts toward safer and more necessity-driven purchasing behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了COVID-19大流行对印度马拉普拉姆地区就业人员消费行为的影响，发现疫情显著改变了消费者优先事项，增加了必需品和卫生用品的支出，减少了非必需品购买，主要影响因素包括封锁限制、健康担忧、供应短缺和收入不确定性。
AI.research_question: 疫情如何影响消费者的购买行为？具体研究：1）影响购买决策的主要因素是什么？2）与疫情前相比，家庭用品消费模式发生了哪些变化？3）消费者在购买必需品时遇到了哪些困难？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行对经济活动和日常生活造成了前所未有的干扰，导致消费者购买行为发生显著变化。研究旨在了解疫情如何重塑消费模式，特别是在危机情境下消费者的行为调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论，特别是危机情境下的消费决策理论，关注外部冲击（如疫情）如何改变消费者的优先级、风险感知和购买模式。
AI.method: 描述性研究，采用主次数据源。通过便利抽样对160名受访者进行结构化问卷调查。使用均值、标准差、变异系数和非参数检验等统计工具分析数据。
AI.findings: 1）疫情显著影响消费者优先级和购买行为；2）消费者增加了必需品和卫生相关产品的支出，减少了非必需品购买；3）主要影响因素包括：封锁限制、健康担忧、供应短缺和收入不确定性；4）危机情境能重塑消费模式，加速向更安全、更需求驱动的购买行为转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）验证了危机情境下消费者行为理论的适用性；2）提供了疫情作为外部冲击如何改变消费模式的实证证据；3）识别了影响危机时期消费决策的关键因素框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业制定危机时期的营销策略提供参考；2）为政策制定者应对类似危机提供消费行为洞察；3）帮助零售商调整库存和供应链管理以适应危机时期的消费需求变化。

title: Labor Risk and the Implied Cost of Equity Capital: Evidence from Firms' Exposure to Opioid Abuse
affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University - School of Accounting and Finance, University of Tennessee, Haslam College of Business, Accounting and Information Management, Fudan University - School of Management, IE Business School - IE University and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Labor Risk and the Implied Cost of Equity Capital: Evidence from Firms' Exposure to Opioid Abuse

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest related to this research.

detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of an important public health emergency on corporate financing costs. We document that firms' higher exposure to opioid abuse is associated with a higher implied cost of equity capital. Relying on the staggered adoption of state-level Prescription Drug Monitoring Programs, which exogenously reduce firms' exposure to opioid abuse, we establish causality. The adverse effects of opioid exposure are exacerbated for firms with low bargaining power relative to their employees, specifically, for firms that are more labor intensive and for those facing more stringent labor protection laws. Moreover, these effects exist for firms relying on high-skilled labor as well as those relying on low-skilled labor. We rule out demand-side risk from opioid-exposed customers as an alternative explanation. Overall, our evidence shows that equity investors can identify labor risk arising from public health emergencies and demand compensation for bearing this risk.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业暴露于阿片类药物滥用风险会增加股权融资成本，而州级处方药监控计划的实施能降低这种风险暴露，从而降低融资成本。这种负面影响在相对于员工议价能力较低的企业中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 公共卫生紧急事件（阿片类药物滥用）如何影响企业融资成本？企业暴露于阿片类药物滥用风险是否会提高股权资本成本？
AI.motivation: 公共卫生紧急事件如阿片类药物滥用危机可能通过影响劳动力市场给企业带来风险，但现有研究较少探讨这种风险如何影响企业融资成本。投资者是否能够识别这种劳动力风险并相应调整资本成本要求？
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险补偿理论，投资者会对承担额外风险要求更高回报；劳动力风险理论，公共卫生事件通过影响员工生产力、出勤率等给企业带来运营风险；议价能力理论，企业与员工之间的相对议价地位会影响风险传导机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID），利用美国各州处方药监控计划（PDMPs）的分阶段实施作为外生冲击，建立因果关系。使用企业层面的阿片类药物暴露程度数据，分析其对隐含股权资本成本的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 企业暴露于阿片类药物滥用风险与更高的隐含股权资本成本正相关；2. PDMPs实施能降低企业风险暴露，从而降低融资成本；3. 这种负面影响在劳动密集型企业、面临更严格劳动保护法的企业（即议价能力较低的企业）中更为显著；4. 影响同时存在于依赖高技能劳动力和低技能劳动力的企业；5. 排除了需求侧风险（来自受阿片类药物影响的客户）的替代解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将公共卫生风险纳入企业融资成本研究框架；2. 揭示了劳动力风险通过议价能力渠道影响企业融资的机制；3. 证明了投资者能够识别并定价公共卫生事件带来的劳动力风险；4. 为风险补偿理论在非传统风险领域的应用提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供了公共卫生风险管理的重要性证据；2. 为政策制定者（如实施PDMPs）提供了降低企业融资成本的政策依据；3. 为投资者评估企业风险提供了新的维度；4. 强调了劳动力保护政策与企业融资成本之间的权衡关系。

title: Crisis, Policy, and Technology: How External Shocks Reallocate Scholarly Attention in Innovation Research
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Crisis, Policy, and Technology: How External Shocks Reallocate Scholarly Attention in Innovation Research
detail.abstract: External shocks can redirect scholarly attention, but little is known about how different types of shocks reshape research agendas across countries. This paper studies how three shocks — the Industrie 4.0 policy initiative (2011), the COVID-19 pandemic (2020), and the public release of ChatGPT (2022) — reallocated direct scholarly attention in innovation research. We analyze 6,162 country-focused innovation studies on South Korea, Japan, Germany, and the United States published between 2000 and 2025, classifying each paper’s direct engagement with each shock using a validated text-based measure.The three shocks produce markedly different attention signatures. COVID-19 generates the fastest and broadest response, appearing across multiple countries within one half-year. By contrast, ChatGPT produces only sparse early signals and enters the published literature more slowly than COVID-19; received-date evidence suggests that this slower appearance reflects researcher response time rather than editorial processing. Industrie 4.0 displays a strikingly different pattern: it appears only after a five-year delay and is heavily concentrated in Germany-focused research. Using a difference-in-differences design, we obtain directional evidence that Germany-focused research exhibits roughly a 1 percentage point higher post-announcement I4.0 attention share, consistent with origin-country amplification. Qualitative thematic coding further shows that German I4.0 research is broadly diagnostic rather than celebratory, focusing on adoption barriers, competency gaps, and related implementation challenges.Together, these findings suggest that scholarly attention is not a neutral reflection of real-world need. Policy-origin shocks and crisis shocks restructure research agendas through different channels and on different timescales, and conceptual ownership of a policy label can diverge from implementation leadership.​

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨三种外部冲击（工业4.0政策、COVID-19疫情、ChatGPT发布）如何重塑创新研究议程。通过分析2000-2025年间6,162篇针对韩国、日本、德国和美国的创新研究论文，发现不同类型的冲击产生显著不同的注意力模式：COVID-19反应最快最广，ChatGPT进入文献较慢，工业4.0延迟五年且高度集中于德国研究。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的冲击（政策倡议、全球危机、技术突破）如何重塑各国创新研究的学术注意力分配？
AI.motivation: 虽然外部冲击能够重新定向学术注意力，但不同冲击类型如何影响跨国研究议程尚不清楚。需要理解政策驱动、危机驱动和技术驱动冲击对学术关注的不同影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于冲击类型理论（政策冲击、危机冲击、技术冲击），注意力分配理论，以及跨国研究议程形成机制。探讨"原产国放大效应"和"概念所有权"等概念。
AI.method: 文本分析方法：分析6,162篇针对四个国家（韩国、日本、德国、美国）的创新研究论文（2000-2025年），使用验证的文本测量方法分类每篇论文对每种冲击的直接关注。采用双重差分设计分析工业4.0的注意力变化。辅以定性主题编码分析德国工业4.0研究内容。
AI.findings: 1. COVID-19产生最快最广泛的响应，半年内出现在多国研究中；2. ChatGPT早期信号稀疏，进入文献速度慢于COVID-19；3. 工业4.0延迟五年出现，且高度集中于德国研究；4. 德国研究在工业4.0宣布后注意力份额约高1个百分点，显示原产国放大效应；5. 德国工业4.0研究主要是诊断性而非庆祝性，关注实施障碍和能力差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分不同类型冲击对学术注意力的差异化影响机制；2. 提出"原产国放大效应"概念；3. 揭示政策标签的概念所有权与实际实施领导权的分离；4. 挑战学术注意力是现实需求中性反映的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解政策倡议如何影响研究议程提供参考；2. 帮助研究机构预测不同类型冲击下的学术响应模式；3. 为期刊编辑处理新兴话题提供时间框架参考；4. 揭示德国工业4.0研究的批判性视角对政策实施的启示。

title: The Standing Deposit Facility in Nigeria: Monetary Policy, Liquidity Management, and Implications for the Banking Sector
affiliations: Nigerian Law School

detail.title: The Standing Deposit Facility in Nigeria: Monetary Policy, Liquidity Management, and Implications for the Banking Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I do not have any personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have influenced, or could be perceived as influencing, my study.
declarations.funderStatement: The research is self-funded.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the sharp rise in Nigerian banks' deposits in the Central Bank of Nigeria's Standing Deposit Facility alongside reported banking losses. It explains how monetary policy reforms, liquidity management, risk aversion, and rising non-performing loans account for this apparent contradiction and assesses the broader implications for financial stability.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚银行在央行常备存款设施中的存款激增与银行报告亏损并存，本文解释了这一矛盾现象源于货币政策改革、流动性管理、风险规避和不良贷款上升，并评估了对金融稳定的影响。
AI.research_question: 为什么尼日利亚银行在央行常备存款设施中的存款激增与银行报告亏损同时发生？这一矛盾现象背后的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 观察到尼日利亚银行系统出现看似矛盾的现象：一方面银行在央行存款激增，另一方面银行报告亏损。这种异常情况需要解释，因为它可能隐藏着金融稳定风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、银行流动性管理理论、风险规避行为理论、不良贷款与银行盈利能力关系理论
AI.method: 基于尼日利亚银行系统的实证分析，结合货币政策改革、流动性数据、银行财务报告和不良贷款数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 货币政策改革导致银行将超额流动性存入央行；2. 银行风险规避行为增加；3. 不良贷款上升侵蚀银行利润；4. 这些因素共同解释了存款激增与银行亏损并存的现象
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对银行行为矛盾现象的理论解释框架，特别是在货币政策改革背景下银行流动性管理与盈利能力的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚央行和监管机构提供政策建议，帮助识别金融稳定风险，改进流动性管理和不良贷款监管

title:
Skill Gaps, Lean Training, and Productivity:
 Exploratory Evidence from an Industrial Policy Program in Brazil
affiliations: Getulio Vargas Foundation, School of Public Policy and Government

detail.title:
Skill Gaps, Lean Training, and Productivity:
 Exploratory Evidence from an Industrial Policy Program in Brazil

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares to have no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The participants were fully informed about their voluntary participation and on the nature of this research, following COPE standards. Access to the raw data is restricted and cannot be transferred to third parties.
declarations.funderStatement: The paper has been developed in colaboration with ILO/CINTERFOR and CEPAL members among the research grant #40509003/0 financed by the CAF.

detail.abstract:
Purpose: The More Productive Brazil (BMP) program is a public policy aimed at improving the productivity of micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises. A novel element of the BMP has been the professional training of employees in Lean manufacturing techniques. This study analyzes the extension of gaps between workers' skills and employer demands, details the BMP's approach, and analyzes whether it leads to successful mitigation using the food manufacturing sector as a case study.

 Approach: Primary data is collected through online questionnaires from managers and participant employees. The empirical strategy follows an evaluation approach, examining whether reported changes in skills and operational performance are consistent with the program's intended mechanisms. Descriptive statistical analysis is used to evaluate the consistency between program design and reported outcomes. 

Findings: The responses indicate that technical skill deficits are the most prominent component of existing skill gaps, compounded by firms' limited resources to support worker training. Respondents broadly acknowledge the negative consequences of these gaps in four dimensions-material waste, errors and rework, delays in production, and low productivity. There is strong agreement that the professional training provided by the BMP caused higher interest in firm productivity, acquisition of new skills, and improved performance along these dimensions.

 Originality: The study contributes new evidence on how workforce-oriented training policies can address productivity constraints in small and medium-sized firms within developing economies. By linking firms' perceived skill gaps to behavioral and performance-related outcomes, it provides insights into mechanisms through which Leanbased training can translate into operational improvements.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了巴西"更高效巴西"（BMP）计划如何通过精益制造培训解决中小企业员工技能差距，发现技术技能不足是最突出的问题，培训显著提高了员工对生产率的兴趣、技能获取和操作绩效。
AI.research_question: BMP计划的精益制造培训是否能成功缓解中小企业员工的技能差距，并转化为操作绩效的改善？
AI.motivation: 巴西中小企业面临生产力挑战，员工技能与企业需求之间存在差距，而企业资源有限难以支持员工培训。BMP计划作为一项公共政策，通过专业培训解决这一问题，但其有效性需要评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技能差距理论、精益制造理论和培训效果评估框架，研究探讨了技能差距如何影响企业绩效，以及培训干预如何通过改变员工行为和技能来改善操作结果。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，收集管理者和参与员工的主要数据，运用描述性统计分析评估项目设计与报告结果之间的一致性，遵循评估研究方法论。
AI.findings: 技术技能不足是现有技能差距中最突出的部分；技能差距导致材料浪费、错误返工、生产延迟和低生产率四个维度的负面影响；BMP培训显著提高了员工对生产率的兴趣、新技能获取和操作绩效改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家中小企业生产力约束的研究提供了新证据；将企业感知的技能差距与行为和绩效结果联系起来；揭示了精益培训转化为操作改进的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于劳动力导向培训政策有效性的实证支持；为企业管理者展示了解决技能差距的具体途径；为食品制造业等特定行业提供了可借鉴的培训模式。

title: Unequal Burden of Growth: Housing Cost Pressures on Renters Near High-Profile Firm Entries
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology and Georgia Institute of Technology

detail.title: Unequal Burden of Growth: Housing Cost Pressures on Renters Near High-Profile Firm Entries

keywords: Firm Entry and Local Economic Shocks

detail.abstract: Attracting high-profile firms is a central place-based development strategy used by state and local governments to boost employment, capital investment, and long-term growth. While the economic spillovers of such firm entries are well documented, their unintended effects on housing markets remain underexplored. This study examines how the arrival of high-profile firms affects rental housing affordability in Georgia communities officially recognized by the state's economic development agency. Using original firm-level data and a near-decade panel of census tract-level affordability outcomes from 2013-2021, we employ staggered difference-indifferences designs to estimate the causal impacts of firm entries on renter cost burdens across income groups. Results show that these entries significantly increase cost burdens among moderate-income renters earning 80-120 percent of the area median income, while effects are muted or negligible for lower-and higher-income renters. The findings challenge conventional wisdom and prevailing narratives that lower-income households are most vulnerable to housing market disruptions; instead, the most pronounced affordability pressures arise among moderate-income renters who often fall outside eligibility for traditional housing assistance. The implications reveal a critical blind spot in both housing policy and economic development discourse, suggesting the need for proactive affordable housing strategies to mitigate uneven consequences of firm-led growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了高知名度企业入驻对佐治亚州社区租赁住房可负担性的影响，发现中等收入租户（收入为地区中位数80-120%）的住房成本负担显著增加，而低收入和高收入租户受影响较小，揭示了经济开发政策中的住房政策盲点。
AI.research_question: 高知名度企业入驻如何影响不同收入群体的租赁住房可负担性？
AI.motivation: 虽然吸引高知名度企业是地方经济发展的重要策略，其经济溢出效应已有充分研究，但对住房市场的意外影响却鲜有探讨，特别是对不同收入群体的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地方经济发展理论、住房市场理论和收入分层理论，研究企业入驻对住房市场的差异化影响机制。
AI.method: 使用企业层面原始数据和2013-2021年人口普查区层面的面板数据，采用交错双重差分设计估计企业入驻对租赁住房成本负担的因果效应。
AI.findings: 高知名度企业入驻显著增加了中等收入租户（收入为地区中位数80-120%）的住房成本负担，而对低收入和高收入租户的影响较小或可忽略。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统观念，即低收入家庭最易受住房市场冲击；揭示了中等收入租户在住房可负担性方面的特殊脆弱性，填补了住房市场与企业入驻关系研究的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了住房政策和经济开发政策中的盲点，建议制定积极的保障性住房策略，以缓解企业驱动增长带来的不平等后果，特别关注中等收入群体的住房需求。

title: Reciprocal Tariff Uncertainty and Sectoral Stock Sensitivity: Evidence from Indian Textiles during the Trump Era
affiliations: Reserve Bank of India and Reserve Bank of India

detail.title: Reciprocal Tariff Uncertainty and Sectoral Stock Sensitivity: Evidence from Indian Textiles during the Trump Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: NIL

detail.abstract: This study examines the evolution of reciprocal tariff uncertainty and its short-run impact on the Indian textile sector during key phases of trade policy signalling under the Trump administration. A mediabased Reciprocal Tariff Sentiment Index is constructed to capture the tone and intensity of tariff-related discussions from September 2024 to September 2025. To assess financial market responses during various phases of uncertainty, the study employs an event-study framework using daily stock price data for major Indian textile firms, with over 40 per cent of sectoral market capitalisation and significant presence in the US market. The results show heterogeneous market reactions across policy events. While the "America First" memorandum in January 2025 generated significantly negative abnormal returns, subsequent announcements that reduced relative uncertainty-particularly the April 2, 2025, Liberation Day tariff clarification-elicited positive market responses. In contrast, later announcements involving higher tariff rates and penalties led to renewed negative reactions, reflecting heightened concerns about trade disruptions. Furthermore, that a one-standard-deviation increase in the U.S. Trade Policy Uncertainty (TPU) index contemporaneously reduces month-over-month textile export growth by approximately 0.1 percentage points, consistent with documented uncertainty aversion in export decisions. Our findings highlight that long-run effects remain ambiguous, reflecting offsetting firmlevel adaptation, supply chain reorientation, and evolving policy expectations; however, our evidence underscores the critical macroeconomic stabilization benefit of transparent, timely trade policy communication. 1 Richa Saini Rawat and Shreya Gupta are both Managers from Monetary Policy Department. The views expressed in the paper are of the authors and do not represent the views of the Reserve Bank of India.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了特朗普政府时期互惠关税不确定性对印度纺织业的短期影响。研究发现市场反应因政策事件而异：增加不确定性的政策导致负面市场反应，而降低不确定性的澄清则引发正面反应。美国贸易政策不确定性指数每增加一个标准差，印度纺织品出口月增长率下降约0.1个百分点。研究强调透明、及时的政策沟通具有宏观经济稳定效益。
AI.research_question: 互惠关税不确定性如何影响印度纺织业在特朗普政府关键贸易政策信号阶段的短期表现？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府的"美国优先"贸易政策引发了全球贸易不确定性，印度纺织业作为对美国市场依赖度较高的行业，面临显著的关税不确定性风险。理解这种不确定性对特定行业的短期影响对于政策制定和企业决策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易政策不确定性理论、事件研究法理论框架，以及不确定性厌恶理论。研究构建了媒体基础的互惠关税情绪指数来量化政策不确定性。
AI.method:
1. 构建媒体基础的互惠关税情绪指数（2024年9月至2025年9月）
2. 采用事件研究法，使用印度主要纺织企业日度股价数据（覆盖行业40%以上市值）
3. 分析美国贸易政策不确定性指数对印度纺织品出口增长的影响
AI.findings:
1. 市场反应具有异质性：2025年1月"美国优先"备忘录导致显著负向异常收益
2. 降低相对不确定性的政策澄清（如2025年4月2日解放日关税澄清）引发正面市场反应
3. 后期涉及更高关税和惩罚的公告导致新的负面反应
4. 美国TPU指数每增加一个标准差，印度纺织品出口月增长率下降约0.1个百分点
5. 长期效应不明确，受企业适应、供应链调整和政策预期变化抵消
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了贸易政策不确定性理论在特定行业和短期影响的应用
2. 开发了媒体基础的互惠关税情绪指数作为不确定性量化工具
3. 验证了不确定性厌恶理论在出口决策中的适用性
4. 为事件研究法在贸易政策分析中的应用提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为印度纺织企业提供应对贸易不确定性的决策参考
2. 为政策制定者强调透明、及时贸易政策沟通的重要性
3. 为投资者提供评估贸易政策风险对特定行业影响的框架
4. 为出口导向型企业提供风险管理策略依据

title: IASCA: The International AI Safety Certification Authority — A Framework for Independent AI Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: IASCA: The International AI Safety Certification Authority — A Framework for Independent AI Governance
detail.abstract: This proposal introduces the International AI Safety Certification Authority (IASCA), an independent, internationally governed body for mandatory pre-deployment safety certification of frontier AI models. Modelled after the IAEA, FAA, and FDA, IASCA employs a zero-knowledge testing architecture that evaluates model safety through behavioural probing without accessing proprietary weights, training data, or architecture. The framework addresses the demonstrated failure of industry self-regulation, proposes a treaty-based governance structure with anti-capture provisions, and outlines a phased implementation roadmap from voluntary pilot to mandatory certification within five years. The economic model follows the FDA's PDUFA precedent, with progressive certification fees representing 0.1-1% of model training costs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出建立国际AI安全认证机构(IASCA)，这是一个独立的国际治理机构，负责对前沿AI模型进行强制性的部署前安全认证。该机构借鉴IAEA、FAA和FDA的模式，采用零知识测试架构评估模型安全性，无需访问专有权重、训练数据或架构。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个有效的国际治理机制，对前沿AI模型进行强制性的部署前安全认证，以解决行业自律失败的问题？
AI.motivation: 行业自律在AI安全方面已被证明失败，需要建立独立的国际治理机构来确保前沿AI模型的安全部署，防止潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴国际原子能机构(IAEA)、联邦航空管理局(FAA)和食品药品监督管理局(FDA)的监管模式，结合零知识测试架构理论，以及基于条约的治理结构理论。
AI.method: 提出建立IASCA机构，采用零知识测试架构通过行为探测评估模型安全性，无需访问专有信息；设计基于条约的治理结构，包含防俘获条款；制定五年分阶段实施路线图。
AI.findings: 提出了一个可行的国际AI安全认证框架，包括机构设计、测试方法、治理结构和经济模型，能够有效解决行业自律失败问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将传统监管机构模式(IAEA、FAA、FDA)应用于AI安全领域；2) 提出零知识测试架构理论；3) 发展了基于条约的国际AI治理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为各国政府提供了具体的AI安全监管实施方案；2) 设计了可操作的分阶段实施路线图；3) 提出了基于FDA PDUFA模式的经济模型，认证费用占模型训练成本的0.1-1%。

title:
Parasitonomics and Parasitocracy:
A Governance Science Framework for Analyzing Democracy Drift

detail.title:
Parasitonomics and Parasitocracy:
A Governance Science Framework for Analyzing Democracy Drift

keywords: Governance Researcher & Focus Governance Developer Status: Governance Education
Analysis and Development Document Audience: Individuals

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces three new socioeconomic terms-Parasitocracy, Parasitocratic, and Parasitonomics-as structural descriptors within governance science. These terms are not ideological labels, nor moral judgments. They are analytical instruments developed to evaluate whether governance systems are structurally constrained to serve the public or structurally aligned to serve power. 
The paper proposes a Democracy-Parasitocracy spectrum and argues that governance drift toward power-serving alignment is predictable when authority is insufficiently constrained by enforceable responsibility. The objective is to establish a neutral diagnostic vocabulary capable of supporting future empirical measurement and comparative analysis.

This framework does not classify specific countries or regimes. It introduces analytical terminology for governance assessment.

This paper contributes to governance science by introducing a structural vocabulary for evaluating public-serving versus power-serving institutional alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三个新的社会经济术语——寄生统治、寄生统治性的和寄生经济学——作为治理科学中的结构性描述符。这些术语不是意识形态标签或道德判断，而是用于评估治理体系在结构上是服务于公众还是服务于权力的分析工具。论文提出了民主-寄生统治光谱，并认为当权力缺乏可执行的责任约束时，治理会向权力服务方向漂移。目标是建立中立的诊断词汇，支持未来的实证测量和比较分析。
AI.research_question: 治理体系在结构上是如何被约束以服务于公众，还是被设计以服务于权力的？如何建立中立的分析框架来评估治理体系的结构性特征？
AI.motivation: 当前治理科学缺乏中立的、结构性的分析术语来评估治理体系是为公众服务还是为权力服务。需要建立非意识形态、非道德判断的分析工具，以便进行客观的治理评估和比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主-寄生统治光谱理论；权力约束理论（权力需要可执行的责任约束）；治理结构对齐理论（治理体系与公众利益或权力利益的结构性对齐）
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建；术语开发方法；理论框架构建；分析工具开发（非实证研究，而是概念框架开发）
AI.findings: 提出了三个核心术语：寄生统治（Parasitocracy）、寄生统治性的（Parasitocratic）和寄生经济学（Parasitonomics）；建立了民主-寄生统治光谱；发现当权力缺乏可执行的责任约束时，治理会向权力服务方向漂移；开发了中立的诊断词汇用于治理评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 为治理科学引入了新的结构性分析词汇；提出了民主-寄生统治光谱理论；发展了权力约束与治理漂移的理论框架；为治理评估提供了非意识形态的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了中立的治理评估工具；支持未来的实证测量和比较分析；为政策制定者和研究者提供了诊断治理体系结构特征的框架；有助于识别治理体系是为公众服务还是为权力服务。

publicationDetails.journalName: Vanderbilt University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Most of us remember learning about natural selection back in school and have a sense of some of its everyday implications, like the risks of overusing antibiotics. Yet there are still many things that most of us fail to appreciate about evolution--including just how useful it can be to understand. Force of Nature explores how we misunderstand and neglect natural selection to our detriment, both missing opportunities to better achieve our goals and, sometimes, even imperiling lives. 

Through vivid and surprising examples ranging from medicine, psychology, and AI to economics, engineering, and beyond, we see how a finer grasp of natural selection can help open new horizons in cancer treatment and space exploration; create faster machines and better robots; design more effective, just laws; and more.  Force of Nature shows how, properly understood, evolution may be even more powerful than we may think.   [This SSRN document provides the Introduction of the book, excerpted with permission.]

AI.tldr: 本书探讨人们如何误解和忽视自然选择，错失实现目标的机会甚至危及生命，并通过多领域案例展示深入理解自然选择如何带来医学、科技、法律等方面的突破。
AI.research_question: 人们如何误解和忽视自然选择？深入理解自然选择如何帮助我们在各个领域更好地实现目标？
AI.motivation: 尽管人们在学校学习过自然选择，但对其日常应用和重要性仍缺乏充分认识，导致错失机会甚至危及生命，需要更深入地理解自然选择的力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于达尔文的自然选择理论，探讨其在现代社会的应用和意义，强调进化论的多领域适用性。
AI.method: 通过多领域案例研究法，包括医学、心理学、人工智能、经济学、工程学等领域的生动实例，展示自然选择的应用。
AI.findings: 深入理解自然选择可以帮助：1) 开辟癌症治疗和太空探索新视野；2) 创造更快的机器和更好的机器人；3) 设计更有效、公正的法律；4) 在各个领域实现突破性进展。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了自然选择理论的应用范围，展示了进化论在现代社会各个领域的理论价值和实践意义，强调进化论比人们通常认为的更强大。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医学、科技、法律等领域的实践者提供了基于自然选择的新思路和方法，帮助解决实际问题，如癌症治疗、机器人设计、法律制定等。

title: CLIMATE POLICY IN A MEAN FIELD GAME OF HETEROGENEOUS COUNTRIES
affiliations: Banque Centrale du Luxembourg and Banque Centrale du Luxembourg

detail.title: CLIMATE POLICY IN A MEAN FIELD GAME OF HETEROGENEOUS COUNTRIES
detail.abstract: Recent empirical evidence reveals an income gradient in support for climate action: individuals in wealthier countries are less willing to pay than those in poorer ones. What explains this gradient, and what does it imply for international cooperation? We answer these questions by developing an integrated assessment model with a continuum of countries, formulated as a mean field game characterized by two partial differential equations and two ordinary differential equations. We calibrate the model usingeconomic and climate data and show that it reproduces key past evolutions. We then quantify the impacts of the introduction of a carbon tax on individual countries. Poorer countries, facing higher marginal utility of consumption, cut consumption less to cushion the decline in capital accumulation caused by climate damages. As a result, they suffer larger relative losses from climate change and gain more from mitigation, making them more inclined to accept a global carbon tax. This gradient has stark implications for cooperation: even when a carbon tax large enough to contain temperature increases benefits most countries, the richest might oppose. Redistributing global carbon tax proceeds uniformly across countries or recycling them as green investment subsidies need not overcome this reluctance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现收入与气候行动支持度呈负相关：富裕国家民众支付意愿较低，而贫穷国家民众更支持全球碳税。这种梯度对国际合作有重要影响，即使碳税能控制温升，最富裕国家仍可能反对。
AI.research_question: 什么解释了气候行动支持度的收入梯度？这种梯度对国际合作意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 实证证据显示富裕国家民众对气候行动的支付意愿低于贫穷国家，需要解释这一现象及其对国际气候合作的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用均值场博弈理论，构建包含连续国家谱系的综合评估模型，包含两个偏微分方程和两个常微分方程。
AI.method: 开发综合评估模型，使用经济和气候数据进行校准，模拟碳税政策对各国的量化影响。
AI.findings: 贫穷国家因消费边际效用较高，为缓冲气候损害导致的资本积累下降而较少削减消费，因此承受更大相对损失，从减排中获益更多，更支持全球碳税。即使碳税能控制温升，最富裕国家仍可能反对。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次用均值场博弈模型解释气候行动支持度的收入梯度，揭示消费边际效用差异如何影响各国气候政策偏好。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出全球碳税再分配或绿色投资补贴可能无法克服富裕国家的反对，为国际气候谈判提供重要政策启示。

title: Blocking the Blockers?
affiliations: Banco de España

detail.title: Blocking the Blockers?
detail.abstract: I study how firms’ defensive investments affect aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) in a general-equilibrium model where incumbents invest both to raise productivity and to deter entry or imitation; entry occurs either by new firms into existing markets or as a leading firm in an entirely new product line. Calibrated to U.S. data to match the joint relationships between intangible investment intensity, firm productivity, market share, and firm size, the model shows that cracking down on defensive investments increases aggregate TFP by 4 percent, driven primarily by higher technical efficiency resulting from improved firm-level productivity. This gain is partially offset by a reduction in product variety; absent this effect, the TFP increase would be twice as large. Profit taxes targeted at single-product leaders—those most prone to block imitation—combined with selective subsidies for entrants introducing new products can strengthen firm-level productivity while limiting losses in product variety. Firm-level evidence from U.S. data supports these mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 研究企业防御性投资如何影响总体全要素生产率（TFP）。防御性投资包括企业为提高生产率和阻止进入/模仿的投资。模型校准美国数据显示，打击防御性投资可使总体TFP提高4%，主要源于企业生产率提升带来的技术效率改进，但部分被产品多样性减少所抵消。针对单产品领导者的利润税结合新产品进入者的选择性补贴可提升企业生产率同时限制产品多样性损失。
AI.research_question: 企业的防御性投资如何影响总体全要素生产率（TFP）？
AI.motivation: 企业投资不仅用于提高生产率，也用于防御竞争（阻止进入或模仿）。这种防御性投资可能扭曲资源配置，影响总体生产率。需要理解这种投资行为对宏观经济效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，企业投资分为生产性投资（提高生产率）和防御性投资（阻止进入/模仿）。进入包括现有市场新企业和全新产品线领导者两种形式。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并校准至美国数据，匹配无形资产投资强度、企业生产率、市场份额和企业规模之间的联合关系。使用企业层面数据进行实证支持。
AI.findings: 打击防御性投资可使总体TFP提高4%，主要源于企业生产率提升带来的技术效率改进。但产品多样性减少部分抵消了这一收益，若无此效应TFP提升可达两倍。针对单产品领导者的利润税结合新产品进入者补贴可提升企业生产率同时限制产品多样性损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建包含防御性投资的宏观经济模型；2）量化防御性投资对总体TFP的影响；3）分析产品多样性在其中的调节作用；4）提出政策组合优化方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为反垄断和竞争政策提供理论依据；2）提出针对性的税收和补贴政策组合；3）帮助企业理解投资决策的宏观影响；4）为政策制定者提供量化参考。

title: Automation, Income Distribution, and Aggregate Demand in a Two-Asset HANK Model
affiliations: Chonnam National University

detail.title: Automation, Income Distribution, and Aggregate Demand in a Two-Asset HANK Model
detail.abstract: Advances in artificial intelligence and robotics are reshaping production, but how does this transformation affect workers and consumers when many households live paycheck to paycheck? We study this question in a macroeconomic model where firms choose how many tasks to automate and households differ in their access to savings. We find that automation lowers wages and the share of income going to workers, reducing spending by households who cannot easily save. During the transition, employment initially booms due to investment but then declines persistently. Monetary policy becomes more powerful in highly automated economies, but cannot fully offset the demand shortfall. These findings suggest that automation policies should combine monetary accommodation with fiscal redistribution to sustain broad-based demand.

AI.tldr: 自动化降低工资和工人收入份额，减少无法储蓄家庭的支出；就业先因投资增加而短暂繁荣，随后持续下降；货币政策在高度自动化经济中更有效，但无法完全弥补需求缺口；政策建议结合货币宽松与财政再分配。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和机器人技术重塑生产时，这种转型如何影响许多靠工资生活的工人和消费者？
AI.motivation: 人工智能和机器人技术正在重塑生产，但许多家庭靠工资生活，这种转型对工人和消费者的影响尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济模型，企业选择自动化任务数量，家庭在储蓄获取能力上存在差异。
AI.method: 使用宏观经济模型分析，其中企业决定自动化程度，家庭存在储蓄能力差异。
AI.findings: 1. 自动化降低工资和工人收入份额，减少无法储蓄家庭的支出；2. 转型期间就业先因投资增加而短暂繁荣，随后持续下降；3. 货币政策在高度自动化经济中更有效，但无法完全弥补需求缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含企业自动化决策和家庭储蓄异质性的宏观经济模型；2. 揭示了自动化对收入分配和总需求的动态影响机制；3. 分析了货币政策在自动化经济中的有效性变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 自动化政策应结合货币宽松与财政再分配；2. 需要维持广泛的需求基础；3. 为政策制定者提供了应对自动化转型的综合框架。

title: The Simulacrum of Intelligence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Simulacrum of Intelligence
detail.abstract:
Four years after ChatGPT's November 2022 launch inaugurated the mainstream "AI era," this paper examines whether large language models (LLMs) constitute genuine intelligence or a convincing simulacrum thereof. Drawing on 40+ sources across computer science, cognitive science, and philosophy of mind, the paper synthesizes seven independent technical lines of evidence — including the stochastic parrot critique (Bender et al., 2021), formal proofs of hallucination inevitability (Xu et al., 2024; Kalai & Vempala, 2024), the fragility of LLM reasoning under trivial perturbation (Mirzadeh et al., 2025), benchmark contamination, absent world models, scaling diminishing returns, and the symbol grounding problem — with four philosophical frameworks: the Chinese Room argument updated for self-learning systems, Floridi's theory of agency without intelligence, the consciousness gap as assessed under Integrated Information Theory and Global Workspace Theory, and Baudrillard's simulacra as applied to machine-generated signs of cognition. 

The analysis finds that these independent dimensions converge on a single conclusion: current LLMs produce statistically sophisticated outputs that mimic the form of intelligence without instantiating its substance. Contemporary deployment evidence (2024–2026) reinforces this finding, with 95% of organizations reporting zero return on generative AI investments, hallucinated legal citations exceeding 700 documented cases, and the scaling hypothesis encountering diminishing returns acknowledged by its own architects. The paper engages the strongest counterarguments — including emergent internal representations, grounding through distributional semantics, and the systems reply to the Chinese Room — and finds them insufficient to bridge the gap between simulation and understanding. 

It concludes by recovering J.C.R. Licklider's (1960) vision of human-computer symbiosis, arguing that the most productive path forward lies not in pursuing artificial general intelligence through current architectures but in the complementary partnership between human judgment and machine computation that the field's founding visionary originally proposed.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过综合技术证据和哲学框架，论证当前的大语言模型（LLMs）只是模拟智能形式而非真正智能，并建议回归人机共生而非追求通用人工智能。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型（LLMs）是否构成真正的智能，还是仅仅是智能的逼真模拟？
AI.motivation: ChatGPT推出四年后，AI时代进入主流，但需要澄清LLMs的本质：是真正的智能还是智能的模拟？这对技术发展、投资决策和哲学理解都至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 技术证据框架：随机鹦鹉批判、幻觉不可避免的形式证明、脆弱推理、基准污染、缺乏世界模型、规模收益递减、符号接地问题
2. 哲学框架：更新版中文房间论证、Floridi的无智能代理理论、整合信息理论和全局工作空间理论下的意识差距、Baudrillard的拟像理论
AI.method: 综合分析方法：整合40+个来自计算机科学、认知科学和心灵哲学的资料源，将七个独立的技术证据线与四个哲学框架相结合进行分析。
AI.findings:
1. 当前LLMs产生统计上复杂的输出，模拟智能形式而非实质
2. 实际部署证据支持这一结论：95%组织报告生成式AI投资零回报、700+个幻觉法律引用案例、规模假设遭遇收益递减
3. 反驳论点（涌现内部表征、分布语义接地、中文房间系统回应）不足以弥合模拟与理解之间的差距
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为LLMs的智能本质问题提供了跨学科的综合分析框架
2. 将技术证据与哲学论证系统结合，澄清了模拟与真正智能的界限
3. 更新了中文房间论证以适用于自学习系统
4. 将Baudrillard的拟像理论应用于机器生成的认知迹象分析
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为组织投资AI提供现实预期：避免对LLMs智能的过度期望
2. 建议转向人机共生模式而非追求通用人工智能
3. 为AI伦理和监管提供理论基础
4. 指导未来AI研究方向的重新定位

title: Cash Crops, Settlement Patterns, and Indigenous Population Growth: The Role of Wine in Colonial Algeria (1900–1950)
affiliations: Universidad de Alcalá, Universitat Barcelona and Charles III University of Madrid

detail.title: Cash Crops, Settlement Patterns, and Indigenous Population Growth: The Role of Wine in Colonial Algeria (1900–1950)
detail.abstract: This paper examines how export-oriented settler agriculture shaped the spatial distribution of indigenous populations in colonial Algeria. By the early twentieth century, Algeria had become one of the world’s largest wine producers and the principal supplier of wine to metropolitan France. We construct a commune-level panel dataset combining census measures of the indigenous population with indicators of viticultural intensity derived from agricultural reports. Exploiting variation in early exposure to viticulture across communes, we show that indigenous population growth became increasingly concentrated in high-viticulture areas from the late 1920s onward, with divergence intensifying during the Great Depression. This pattern is consistent with in-migration driven by the relatively continuous labor demand of viticulture—unlike more seasonal crops—followed by reduced outward mobility as alternative employment opportunities contracted. These findings indicate persistent spatial differences in population growth across communes. This study provides systematic quantitative evidence linking the labor demands of settler monoculture to the spatial concentration of indigenous populations in colonial Algeria.

AI.tldr: 本文研究出口导向的殖民农业如何塑造了阿尔及利亚殖民地土著人口的空间分布。通过构建市镇级面板数据，发现从1920年代末起，土著人口增长越来越集中在葡萄种植密集区，大萧条期间分化加剧，这与葡萄种植相对持续的劳动力需求驱动的人口迁入有关。
AI.research_question: 出口导向的殖民农业如何影响阿尔及利亚殖民地土著人口的空间分布？
AI.motivation: 阿尔及利亚在20世纪初成为世界最大的葡萄酒生产国和法国的主要葡萄酒供应地，但殖民农业对土著人口空间分布的影响缺乏系统性定量研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民经济地理学、劳动力迁移理论、农业劳动力需求与人口分布关系理论
AI.method: 构建市镇级面板数据集，结合人口普查数据和农业报告中的葡萄种植强度指标，利用早期葡萄种植暴露的跨市镇变异进行因果推断
AI.findings: 从1920年代末开始，土著人口增长日益集中在高葡萄种植区，大萧条期间分化加剧；葡萄种植相对持续的劳动力需求驱动人口迁入，随后因替代就业机会减少而减少外迁
AI.theory_contributions: 为殖民经济地理学提供系统性定量证据，阐明殖民农业劳动力需求如何塑造土著人口空间分布，深化对殖民经济结构与人口动态关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了殖民农业政策对人口分布的长期影响，为理解殖民地社会空间结构提供实证基础，对研究殖民遗产和区域发展有参考价值

title: A Comparative Analysis of Regulatory Sandboxes: Models, Evolution and Strategic Implications in EU, USA and China
affiliations: University San Raffaele Roma and European University of Rome

detail.title: A Comparative Analysis of Regulatory Sandboxes: Models, Evolution and Strategic Implications in EU, USA and China
detail.abstract: The article compares the design, evolution, and strategic uses of regulatory sandboxes across the European Union, the United States, and the People’s Republic of China. Using a comparative lens to conduct an analysis of law and politics, the authors demonstrate that sandboxes are not neutral test beds but rather jurisdiction-specific governance instruments that strike a balance between innovation, legality, risk, and market structure. The European Union trajectory shifts from soft-law facilitators to hard-law experimentation, most visibly evident in the DLT Pilot Regime and the AI Act’s mandatory sandboxes, which embed proportionality, rights, and supervisory convergence while exposing the “sandbox paradox” of potential competitive distortions. The United States landscape is presented as decentralized, with dynamic state programs coexisting with cautious federal soft law, yielding agility but weak interoperability and uneven consumer protection. The People’s Republic of China model is analyzed as centrally steered, soft-law heavy, and incumbent-oriented, aligning pilots with industrial policy, financial stability and technological sovereignty, yet marked by opacity and limited open access. Sandboxes thus appear as transitional constitutional technologies: effective when disciplined by legality, accountability and competitive neutrality, and when used to inform, not replace, enduring regulatory reform.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了欧盟、美国和中国在监管沙盒设计、演变和战略应用方面的差异，指出沙盒并非中立测试平台，而是具有司法管辖区特色的治理工具，在创新、合法性、风险和市场竞争之间寻求平衡。
AI.research_question: 不同司法管辖区（欧盟、美国、中国）的监管沙盒在设计、演变和战略应用方面有何差异？这些差异如何反映各自的法律政治体系特点？
AI.motivation: 随着金融科技和人工智能等新兴技术的快速发展，各国纷纷采用监管沙盒来平衡创新与监管。然而，不同司法管辖区的沙盒模式存在显著差异，需要系统比较分析其设计逻辑、演变路径和战略应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与政治比较分析框架；监管沙盒作为治理工具的理论；创新与监管平衡理论；"沙盒悖论"概念（竞争扭曲风险）；过渡性宪法技术理论。
AI.method: 比较法分析；法律政治学分析；案例研究（欧盟DLT试点制度和AI法案、美国联邦与州级项目、中国中央指导模式）；文献分析。
AI.findings:
1. 欧盟从软法促进转向硬法实验，DLT试点制度和AI法案中的强制性沙盒体现了比例原则、权利保护和监管趋同，但存在"沙盒悖论"的竞争扭曲风险。
2. 美国模式分散化，动态的州级项目与谨慎的联邦软法并存，灵活性高但互操作性弱，消费者保护不均衡。
3. 中国模式中央指导、软法为主、偏向现有企业，沙盒与产业政策、金融稳定和技术主权目标一致，但透明度低、开放访问有限。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出监管沙盒是司法管辖区特定的治理工具而非中立测试平台。
2. 发展"沙盒悖论"概念，揭示沙盒可能导致的竞争扭曲。
3. 将沙盒概念化为"过渡性宪法技术"，强调其在法律约束、问责和竞争中立下的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供不同沙盒模式的比较框架。
2. 强调沙盒应受法律、问责和竞争中立的约束。
3. 建议沙盒应作为信息收集工具而非替代持久性监管改革。
4. 为跨国企业提供不同司法管辖区监管环境的理解。

title: Institutional Field Dynamics: A Force Field Model of Multi-Actor Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Institutional Field Dynamics: A Force Field Model of Multi-Actor Governance
detail.abstract: Institutional theory describes mechanisms of isomorphism, inertia, and path dependence, but these accounts remain largely qualitative and do not generate quantitative predictions about which institutional configurations produce which dynamics. This paper formalizes institutional dynamics as a force field system in which actors move through an institutional configuration space under three types of force: intrinsic motivation toward individual ideals, social influence mediated by an asymmetric power matrix, and institutional pressure imposed by policy architecture. Policy is modeled not as direct instruction but as transformation of the field itself. The model generates diagnostic metrics-coherence, friction, and power asymmetry-that characterize the structural health of an institutional configuration. Extensions include relational utility functions that make cooperation and conflict endogenous, dynamic evolution of the power matrix through interaction, and explicit attractor analysis that tests whether policy genuinely transforms the institutional landscape or merely shifts positions within it. A demonstration case-Dutch tailored education reform (Passend Onderwijs, 2014)-shows that the model identifies structural failure modes that qualitative analysis alone does not predict: the reform produced multiple competing attractors under the actual policy configuration, with teacher outcomes spanning the entire configuration space depending on initial conditions, versus structurally convergent outcomes under an alternative configuration with symmetric influence and compatible incentives. Robustness analysis confirms that multi-stability persists across ±50% parameter perturbation and six alternative expert configurations. The model identifies structural multi-stability as a computable property of institutional configurations, enabling ex ante diagnosis of policy fragility. The framework applies as a computational diagnostic layer on top of existing institutional theory to any multi-actor governance context where mandated actors engage with committed institutional architectures, including advisory governance, regulatory design, and participatory democracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文将制度动态形式化为力场系统，开发了诊断制度结构健康的计算模型，并通过荷兰教育改革案例展示了模型如何识别定性分析无法预测的结构性失效模式。
AI.research_question: 如何形式化制度动态以生成定量预测，识别哪些制度配置会产生哪些动态，特别是如何诊断政策脆弱性和结构性失效模式？
AI.motivation: 现有制度理论主要停留在定性描述同构、惯性和路径依赖机制，缺乏定量预测能力，无法预测特定制度配置会产生何种动态结果，特别是政策脆弱性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、力场系统理论、吸引子分析、多稳定性理论、社会影响力理论、制度压力理论。
AI.method: 将制度动态形式化为力场系统模型，包含三种作用力：内在动机、社会影响力（通过非对称权力矩阵）、制度压力（通过政策架构）。开发诊断指标（一致性、摩擦、权力不对称），进行吸引子分析和稳健性测试。
AI.findings: 荷兰教育改革案例显示，实际政策配置产生了多个竞争性吸引子，教师结果取决于初始条件；而替代配置（对称影响和兼容激励）则产生结构收敛结果。模型识别出结构性多稳定性是制度配置的可计算属性，可用于事前诊断政策脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将制度动态形式化为可计算模型；2. 提出诊断制度结构健康的指标；3. 识别结构性多稳定性作为政策脆弱性的关键机制；4. 为制度理论提供计算诊断层。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供事前政策脆弱性诊断工具；2. 识别结构性失效模式；3. 应用于多行动者治理情境（咨询治理、监管设计、参与式民主）；4. 帮助政策设计者避免多稳定性陷阱。

title: Stablecoins and the Global Dollar System
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco

detail.title: Stablecoins and the Global Dollar System
detail.abstract: The dollar has served for almost a century as the dominant global currency for trade, settlement, and reserve purposes, creating immense benefits for the United States.  Amid recent concerns that the dollar’s grip may be weakening, key policymakers view the emergence of dollar-pegged stablecoins—cryptocurrencies that promise to maintain a value of $1 per token—as a tool to help entrench the dollar’s hegemonic status.  Continued dollar dominance may benefit the United States, but wide uptake of stablecoins could significantly undermine U.S. policy interests along two other dimensions: maintaining financial stability and leveraging the global payment system for law enforcement and foreign policy purposes.  Congress recently attempted to provide regulatory clarity for stablecoins in order to bolster dollar hegemony while addressing these risks with the passage of the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act) in the summer of 2025.  This Essay argues that the Act falls short of addressing the risks, explores the implications of these shortcomings, and considers possible policy responses.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美元挂钩稳定币如何影响美元霸权地位，分析GENIUS法案在应对金融稳定性和执法风险方面的不足，并提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 美元挂钩稳定币的广泛采用如何影响美国的政策利益，特别是美元霸权、金融稳定性和执法能力？GENIUS法案是否有效应对这些风险？
AI.motivation: 美元作为全球主导货币近一个世纪，为美国带来巨大利益。近期担忧美元地位可能削弱，政策制定者将美元挂钩稳定币视为巩固美元霸权的工具。然而，稳定币的广泛采用可能威胁美国的金融稳定性和执法能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币霸权理论、金融稳定性理论、监管经济学、国际支付系统理论
AI.method: 政策分析、法律文本分析、风险评估框架、案例研究（GENIUS法案）
AI.findings: 1. 美元挂钩稳定币确实有助于巩固美元霸权地位；2. 但稳定币的广泛采用会威胁金融稳定性并削弱美国利用支付系统进行执法和外交政策的能力；3. GENIUS法案未能充分应对这些风险
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了货币霸权理论，纳入数字货币维度；2. 提出了稳定币对传统货币政策的挑战框架；3. 建立了数字货币监管与国家安全利益的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了GENIUS法案的监管漏洞；2. 提出了改进稳定币监管的政策建议；3. 为政策制定者平衡美元霸权与风险管控提供实用指导

title: The Adaptive Signaling Economy
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Adaptive Signaling Economy
detail.abstract:
LStandard economic theory models individuals as rational agents maximizing utility under constraints. While behavioral economics has introduced psychological deviations from rationality, it still largely abstracts from the evolutionary origins of economic behavior.

This paper proposes a unifying framework, The Adaptive Signaling Economy (ASE), grounded in ethology and evolutionary biology. We argue that a substantial share of human economic behavior is best understood as adaptive signaling, inherited from animal social systems, where economic actions primarily function to signal status, fitness, trustworthiness, and group membership rather than to maximize material payoff alone.

By integrating animal signaling theory, evolutionary stable strategies, and economic choice, we formalize a model in which markets operate as signaling arenas. The framework explains persistent economic anomalies such as conspicuous consumption, unpaid labor, excessive competition, speculative behavior, and reputation-driven markets. The theory generates testable predictions that diverge from both neoclassical and standard behavioral models, offering a biologically grounded foundation for economic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于进化生物学的统一框架——适应性信号经济（ASE），认为人类经济行为很大程度上是适应性信号传递的体现，继承自动物社会系统，经济行动主要功能是传递地位、适应性、可信度和群体归属信号，而不仅仅是最大化物质收益。
AI.research_question: 如何从进化生物学角度理解人类经济行为？经济行为在多大程度上是适应性信号传递的体现，而非纯粹的物质收益最大化？
AI.motivation: 标准经济学将个体建模为理性效用最大化者，行为经济学引入了心理偏差但仍忽略了经济行为的进化起源。需要建立一个基于进化生物学的统一框架来解释经济行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应性信号经济（ASE）框架，整合动物信号理论、进化稳定策略和经济选择理论，将市场视为信号传递的竞技场。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过整合动物信号理论、进化稳定策略和经济选择理论，形式化一个市场作为信号传递竞技场的模型。
AI.findings: 框架能够解释持续性经济异常现象，如炫耀性消费、无偿劳动、过度竞争、投机行为和声誉驱动市场。这些现象在适应性信号传递框架下得到统一解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个基于进化生物学的统一经济分析框架；2）将经济行为重新概念化为适应性信号传递；3）生成了与古典经济学和标准行为模型不同的可检验预测；4）为经济分析提供了生物学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为理解现实经济现象提供新视角；2）有助于设计更符合人类本性的经济政策；3）为企业理解消费者行为提供进化心理学基础；4）为解释市场异常现象提供系统框架。

title: A Behavioral Analysis of Dual-Interpreted News Events
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Behavioral Analysis of Dual-Interpreted News Events
detail.abstract:
This research paper delves into the dual-interpretation nature of some news events-moments where headlines trigger conflicting market signals – and how this market condition drives price discovery. EMH (Fama, 1970) Suggests that information is ‘priced in’ instantly. However, real-world markets are rarely that clear. By Analyzing over thousands news events and categorizing them based on market participants’ reaction and behavior, I have mentioned few news headlines that carries ambiguous, multi-layered narrative. I will use one news event covering the Recessionary pivot narrative after the August 4th 2024 Nonfarm payroll release.

My findings suggest that purely quantitative models often fail during these regime shifts because they lack situational awareness. To solve this, I propose a "Dynamic Execution" framework—a hybrid approach that blends context-heavy programming with discretionary human oversight.  Ultimately, the data shows that in today’s markets, the context surrounding a headline is just as vital for valuation as the news itself.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了具有双重解读性质的新闻事件如何影响市场价格发现，发现纯量化模型在制度转换期间失效，提出结合情境编程和人工监督的动态执行框架。
AI.research_question: 具有双重解读性质的新闻事件如何影响市场价格发现？纯量化模型为何在这些制度转换期间失效？如何设计更好的框架来处理这种市场条件？
AI.motivation: 有效市场假说认为信息会立即被定价，但现实市场很少如此清晰。某些新闻头条会触发冲突的市场信号，这种双重解读性质的市场条件对价格发现过程产生重要影响，而现有量化模型缺乏情境意识来处理这种复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说（Fama, 1970）作为理论基础，但研究挑战其"信息立即定价"的假设。重点关注市场微观结构、行为金融学中的认知偏差，以及制度转换理论。
AI.method: 分析数千个新闻事件，基于市场参与者反应和行为进行分类。使用案例研究方法，特别关注2024年8月4日非农就业数据发布后的衰退性转向叙事。
AI.findings: 纯量化模型在制度转换期间经常失效，因为它们缺乏情境意识。新闻头条的上下文环境与新闻本身对估值同样重要。具有双重解读性质的新闻事件会触发冲突的市场信号，影响价格发现过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战有效市场假说的简化假设，强调情境在价格发现中的重要性。为制度转换期间的市场行为提供新的理论视角，扩展了行为金融学在新闻解读中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"动态执行"框架，结合情境密集型编程和人工监督。为交易员和投资者提供处理双重解读新闻事件的实用方法。改进量化模型在复杂市场条件下的表现。

title: Reality Salience: Neurocognitive Prioritization of Information in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Reality Salience: Neurocognitive Prioritization of Information in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract:
Human cognition depends on the ability to distinguish external reality from imagination, inference, or fabrication. While narratives can influence beliefs regardless of factual status, the mechanisms by which the brain assigns differential priority to reality-relevant information remain under-theorized. This paper introduces the concept of reality salience, defined as the degree to which information is processed as consequential for real-world action and therefore receives enhanced weighting within attentional, mnemonic, and decision-making systems.

Integrating research on reality and source monitoring, narrative transportation, epistemic vigilance, dual-process cognition, and neuroimaging of factual versus fictional processing, the paper proposes a three-stage neurocognitive model comprising source inference, authenticity evaluation, and priority allocation. The model explains how authenticity judgments modulate trust calibration, memory consolidation, and behavioral readiness.

The rise of AI-generated media introduces a novel epistemic condition in which traditional authenticity cues—such as fluency and coherence—are decoupled from the epistemic constraints and accountability structures that typically render them informative in human communication. This decoupling may miscalibrate evaluative processes, leading to over-acceptance of synthetic content or generalized distrust. The paper derives testable predictions regarding cognition in AI-saturated information environments and outlines implications for epistemic resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"现实显著性"概念，解释大脑如何区分现实与虚构信息，并建立三阶段神经认知模型。在AI生成内容时代，传统真实性线索与认知约束脱钩，可能导致认知失调。
AI.research_question: 大脑如何区分外部现实与想象、推理或虚构信息？在AI生成内容充斥的环境中，认知系统如何校准真实性判断？
AI.motivation: 人类认知依赖于区分现实与虚构的能力，但大脑如何为现实相关信息分配优先权的机制尚未充分理论化。AI生成媒体的兴起创造了新的认知条件，传统真实性线索与认知约束脱钩，可能破坏认知系统的校准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合现实与来源监控、叙事沉浸、认知警惕、双过程认知、事实与虚构处理的神经影像研究。提出现实显著性概念和三阶段神经认知模型（来源推断、真实性评估、优先级分配）。
AI.method: 理论整合与模型构建方法。整合多个认知神经科学领域的研究成果，构建概念框架和神经认知模型，并推导可检验的预测。
AI.findings: 提出现实显著性作为信息处理的核心概念，建立三阶段神经认知模型解释真实性判断如何调节信任校准、记忆巩固和行为准备。在AI环境中，传统真实性线索（如流畅性和连贯性）与认知约束脱钩，可能导致过度接受合成内容或普遍不信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"现实显著性"新概念；2. 建立三阶段神经认知模型；3. 解释AI环境下认知失调的机制；4. 为认知弹性研究提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI生成内容的认知影响提供分析框架；2. 提出可检验的预测指导实证研究；3. 为认知弹性培养提供启示；4. 对媒体素养教育和信息环境设计有实践意义。

title: Absorptive Financial Resilience and Investment Stability Under Critical-Metal Price Volatility

detail.title: Absorptive Financial Resilience and Investment Stability Under Critical-Metal Price Volatility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. No external financial support was received for the preparation of my article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research presented in this paper is based on macrofinancial analysis using publicly available data and does not involve human participants or identifiable personal information. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. I fully self-funded my research.

detail.abstract: Recent macro-financial perturbations in the real global economy have unveiled strident differences in economies' capacity to maintain investment amidst market instability, stressing the increasing policy worth of financial resilience as a buffering anchor of actual market activity. This paper introduces a combined econometric exploration of financial resilience (AFRI) as a determining factor of domestic investment under both financial vulnerability (FVI) and commodity market volatility (CMPV) across 82 economies, covering the 2005-2024 period. This paper builds on the IMF's resilience framework (IMF, 2023), to develop and test four hypotheses about linear interaction, nonlinear, and distributional impacts of absorptive resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了金融韧性（AFRI）在金融脆弱性（FVI）和商品市场波动（CMPV）背景下对国内投资的决定作用，基于IMF韧性框架对82个经济体进行实证分析
AI.research_question: 金融韧性（AFRI）如何影响国内投资，特别是在金融脆弱性和商品市场波动的背景下？
AI.motivation: 全球经济宏观金融扰动揭示了各国在市场不稳定时期维持投资能力的显著差异，强调了金融韧性作为实际市场活动缓冲锚的政策价值日益重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际货币基金组织（IMF）的韧性框架（IMF, 2023），构建了关于吸收性韧性的线性交互、非线性和分布影响的理论假设
AI.method: 对82个经济体（2005-2024年）进行组合计量经济学探索，分析金融韧性（AFRI）作为国内投资决定因素的作用，考虑金融脆弱性（FVI）和商品市场波动（CMPV）的影响
AI.findings: 论文基于IMF框架测试了四个关于吸收性韧性的线性交互、非线性和分布影响的假设，具体结果需要查看完整论文
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了基于IMF韧性框架的金融韧性理论，提出了关于金融韧性对投资影响的线性、非线性和分布效应的理论假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过增强金融韧性来缓冲金融脆弱性和商品市场波动对投资影响的实证依据，具有重要的政策参考价值

title: Simulating Residential Growth in Fragmented Housing Markets: A Stepwise Model for Cape Town
affiliations: City of Cape Town, City of Cape Town, City of Cape Town and City of Cape Town

detail.title: Simulating Residential Growth in Fragmented Housing Markets: A Stepwise Model for Cape Town

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was commissioned by the City of Cape Town. The authors declare no other competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was commissioned by the City of Cape Town. The authors declare no other competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: How do cities confronted with fragmented housing markets and asymmetrical market information forecast long-term housing supply, a critical informant to medium-and long-term infrastructure planning? How do they navigate the inherent complexity of simulating the interaction between formal, informal and Statesubsidised housing markets, whilst ensuring that the method remains transparent, tractable and accessible to non-technical stakeholders? We address this question by developing a spreadsheet-based residential simulation model, STREAM (the Stepwise Residential Equilibrium and Allocation Model), and applying it to Cape Town, South Africa. Following an initial baseline calibration of housing demand, available stock, and solution of equilibrium threshold prices across nine submarkets, the model performs stepwise year-on-year adjustments governed by long-term drivers of housing demand, empirically estimated supply elasticities, price adjustment lags, and submarket interaction rules. The model produces annual dwelling projections across nine submarkets for each year to 2050, enabling scenario testing under alternative growth and policy assumptions. Application to Cape Town illustrates how a pragmatic, accessible tool can support planning for land use and infrastructure investment. The model offers a structured and replicable way of linking population and income growth to housing outcomes in a metropolitan context.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于电子表格的住宅模拟模型STREAM，用于预测长期住房供应，并应用于南非开普敦。模型通过九个子市场的均衡价格阈值、需求驱动因素和供给弹性，生成到2050年的年度住房预测，支持土地利用和基础设施规划。
AI.research_question: 城市如何在住房市场碎片化和信息不对称的情况下预测长期住房供应？如何模拟正式、非正式和补贴住房市场的复杂互动，同时确保方法对非技术利益相关者透明、易理解且可访问？
AI.motivation: 城市面临碎片化住房市场和信息不对称的挑战，需要可靠的长期住房供应预测来指导中长期基础设施规划。现有方法往往过于复杂，难以让非技术利益相关者参与和理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住宅市场均衡理论、住房子市场理论、供给弹性理论、价格调整滞后理论、住房需求驱动因素理论
AI.method: 开发基于电子表格的STREAM模型，包含九个住房子市场，通过基准校准、均衡价格阈值计算、逐年调整（基于长期需求驱动因素、供给弹性、价格调整滞后和子市场互动规则）来预测住房供应。
AI.findings: STREAM模型成功应用于开普敦，生成了到2050年九个子市场的年度住房预测，支持不同增长和政策假设下的情景测试。模型展示了实用、可访问的工具如何支持土地利用和基础设施投资规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结构化、可复制的框架，将人口和收入增长与都市住房结果联系起来；发展了模拟碎片化住房市场（正式、非正式、补贴市场）互动的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了透明、易操作的住房预测工具；支持中长期基础设施规划决策；使非技术利益相关者能够参与规划过程；为开普敦等类似城市的住房规划提供了具体应用案例。

title: Tax Policy and Housing Markets: House Prices, Mortgage Credit, and Delinquency

detail.title: Tax Policy and Housing Markets: House Prices, Mortgage Credit, and Delinquency
detail.abstract: I study how personal income taxes (PIT) affect local house prices and show that PITinduced changes in households' disposable income operate through two margins: households' home-purchase demand and mortgagors' debt-repayment capacity, which shapes lenders' credit risk and the supply of new mortgage credit. Exploiting U.S. state-level PIT reforms enacted between 2000 and 2022, I implement a stacked difference-indifferences design in a borderdiscontinuity framework that compares adjacent county pairs across state borders. I find that a one percentage-point increase (cut) in the PIT rate lowers (raises) house prices in the affected county by 5.2% relative to the adjacent cross border counterpart. On the household side, I find a decline in mortgage applications and in county population, both consistent with weaker housing demand. On the lender side, PIT increases are followed by higher mortgage delinquency at the state level and a tightening of credit supply in treated counties, as reflected in higher denial rates and lower origination rates. Consistent with a risk-management response, I also find evidence of liquidity and funding pressures on the balance sheets of the most exposed banks, and that these lenders tighten credit supply more than banks that are less exposed to state-specific conditions. The same framework implies the opposite responses following PIT cuts. Overall, the evidence suggests that the demand margin is more salient following PIT cuts, whereas the credit-risk and credit-supply margin is more salient following PIT increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究个人所得税如何影响地方房价，发现税收变化通过两个渠道发挥作用：家庭购房需求（需求侧）和抵押贷款人还款能力影响信贷风险与供给（供给侧）。利用美国州级税改数据，发现税率每提高1个百分点，受影响县房价相对相邻跨州县下降5.2%。
AI.research_question: 个人所得税如何影响地方房价？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解税收政策对房地产市场的影响机制，特别是个人所得税如何通过家庭需求侧和信贷供给侧双重渠道影响房价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两个边际理论：1) 家庭购房需求边际（可支配收入变化影响住房需求）；2) 信贷风险与供给边际（借款人还款能力影响银行信贷风险与供给决策）。
AI.method: 采用堆叠双重差分设计，结合边界不连续性框架，比较2000-2022年间美国州级个人所得税改革期间相邻跨州县对。
AI.findings: 1) 个人所得税率每提高1个百分点，受影响县房价相对相邻县下降5.2%；2) 需求侧：抵押贷款申请和县人口减少；3) 供给侧：抵押贷款违约率上升，信贷供给收紧（拒绝率提高，发放率降低）；4) 银行资产负债表面临流动性压力；5) 减税时需求边际更显著，增税时信贷风险边际更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统识别个人所得税影响房价的双重渠道机制；2) 建立税收政策、家庭需求与信贷供给的整合理论框架；3) 揭示不同税收方向（增税vs减税）下主导机制的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供税收政策影响房地产市场的量化证据；2) 帮助银行和金融机构理解税收变化对信贷风险的影响；3) 为地方政府评估税收政策的经济后果提供参考。

title: Externalities of Housing Upgrading in High-density Cities
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN), University of International Business and Economics, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN), Singapore Management University, Singapore Management University and Singapore Management University - School of Economics

detail.title: Externalities of Housing Upgrading in High-density Cities
detail.abstract: This paper estimates the magnitude and spatial reach of housing externalities in a highdensity urban setting using Singapore's Main Upgrading Programme, the sole nationwide large-scale public housing upgrading initiative between 1990 and 2006. Exploiting staggered implementation and controlling for nonrandom neighborhood exposure, we find that upgrading raises resale prices of nearby units within 500 meters by approximately 2.1%, while driving up the resale price by about 11.74% for the treated blocks upon completion of upgrading; effects decay to zero beyond 1,000 meters.
