AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出了五项具体政策建议：强制企业问责、取消化石燃料补贴、征收全球团结税、将生态灭绝定为国际犯罪、建立公平的多利益相关方伙伴关系
2. 为国际组织和政府提供了实施SDG 16和17的具体路径
3. 为地方环境正义运动提供了全球治理层面的支持框架
4. 为企业转型提供了明确的问责机制
5. 为全球社会契约的重构提供了实践指导

title: Information and Policy Shocks in Monetary Surprises
affiliations: Warwick University - University of Warwick and University of Warwick - Department of Economics

detail.title: Information and Policy Shocks in Monetary Surprises

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding to declare.

detail.abstract: This short note extends the approach proposed in Miranda-Agrippino and Ricco (2021) that disentangles monetary policy surprises into macroeconomic information and policy shocks, to include the zero lower bound (ZLB) period and the introduction of unconventional monetary policy which followed the Great Recession. The note details the construction of the information-robust instrument used to identify conventional monetary policy shocks, and provides some discussion on the Delphic and Odyssean components in the forward path of monetary policy surprises at longer maturities.

AI.tldr: 这篇短文扩展了Miranda-Agrippino和Ricco(2021)的方法，将零利率下限时期和非常规货币政策纳入分析，详细构建了信息稳健工具来识别传统货币政策冲击，并讨论了货币政策意外中德尔菲式和奥德赛式成分。
AI.research_question: 如何将零利率下限时期和非常规货币政策纳入货币政策冲击的分解框架，以及如何识别传统货币政策冲击并分析货币政策意外中的不同成分？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注传统货币政策时期，需要扩展分析方法以涵盖零利率下限时期和非常规货币政策，以更全面地理解货币政策冲击的构成和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Miranda-Agrippino和Ricco(2021)的框架，将货币政策意外分解为宏观经济信息冲击和纯政策冲击，并扩展到零利率下限和非常规货币政策环境。
AI.method: 构建信息稳健工具来识别传统货币政策冲击，扩展原有方法以涵盖零利率下限时期，分析货币政策意外在较长期限上的德尔菲式和奥德赛式成分。
AI.findings: 成功将分析方法扩展到零利率下限和非常规货币政策时期，提供了识别传统货币政策冲击的工具构建方法，并深入探讨了货币政策意外中不同成分的特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了货币政策冲击分解的理论框架，使其适用于零利率下限和非常规货币政策环境，为理解不同货币政策时期的冲击构成提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了分析零利率下限时期货币政策冲击的实用方法，有助于央行和政策制定者更好地理解货币政策传导机制，特别是在非常规货币政策环境下。

title: Sectoral and Systemic Green Minus Brown Portfolios
affiliations: University of Turin - Collegio Carlo Alberto, Polytechnic University of Milan, University of Turin and University of Bologna

detail.title: Sectoral and Systemic Green Minus Brown Portfolios

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge financial support under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (NRRP), Mission 4, Component 2, Investment 1.1, Call for tender No. 1409 published on 14.9.2022 by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR), funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU– Project Title "Measuring, managing and hedging indirect climate-transition risks" – CUP P20228CHNL - Grant Assignment Decree No. 1376 adopted on 01/09/2023 by the Italian Ministry of Ministry of University and Research (MUR).

detail.abstract: This paper constructs Green Minus Brown (GMB) portfolios at the sector level and combines them into a GMB systemic portfolio, using output multipliers. This systemic portfolio captures an economy-wide measure of greenness, capturing how the shocks in green vs. brown performance heterogeneity at the sectoral level transfer to the economy as a whole. We find that the portfolio, when included in standard linear asset pricing models, helps explain the cross-section of European listed firms' stock returns over the period 2011-2022. We show that the portfolio bears a risk that is priced by the market. Its risk premium is negative and heterogeneous across sectors and time periods. The results are robust to sample selection within the EU. We find that risk premia are significantly larger when factors are constructed using purely environmental rather than ESG-based measures.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了基于行业层面的绿色减棕色(GMB)投资组合，通过产出乘数组合成系统性GMB投资组合，作为衡量经济整体绿色程度的指标。研究发现该投资组合能解释欧洲上市公司股票收益的横截面差异，其风险被市场定价且风险溢价为负值，在不同行业和时期存在异质性。
AI.research_question: 绿色减棕色(GMB)系统性投资组合能否解释欧洲上市公司股票收益的横截面差异？该投资组合的风险是否被市场定价？其风险溢价有何特征？
AI.motivation: 需要衡量经济整体绿色程度，了解行业层面绿色与棕色绩效异质性的冲击如何传导至整个经济，并检验环境因素在资产定价中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论，线性资产定价模型，风险溢价理论，绿色金融与环境风险定价理论。
AI.method: 构建行业层面的GMB投资组合，使用产出乘数组合成系统性GMB投资组合，将其纳入标准线性资产定价模型，分析2011-2022年欧洲上市公司股票收益的横截面数据。
AI.findings: 1. GMB系统性投资组合能解释欧洲上市公司股票收益的横截面差异；2. 该投资组合的风险被市场定价；3. 风险溢价为负值；4. 风险溢价在不同行业和时期存在异质性；5. 使用纯环境指标构建因子时风险溢价显著大于使用ESG综合指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了衡量经济整体绿色程度的新方法；2. 验证了环境风险在资产定价中的重要性；3. 区分了纯环境指标与ESG综合指标在风险定价中的差异；4. 扩展了线性资产定价模型的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了衡量环境风险的新工具；2. 帮助投资者理解绿色投资的风险收益特征；3. 为政策制定者提供了评估经济绿色转型风险的参考；4. 强调了在投资决策中区分纯环境指标与ESG指标的重要性。

title:
The Talebian Architecture of Survival in Nonlinear Markets 
The Clock of Regimes Model
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics, University of Latvia and

detail.title:
The Talebian Architecture of Survival in Nonlinear Markets 
The Clock of Regimes Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no special interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No approval needed as no patients or participants were used in this study
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We introduce the Clock of Regimes (COR) model as a new class of regime-switching model characterized by the 𝑁 =-𝐾-1 operator, which does not exist in classical Hidden Markov Model (HMM) theory. In a conventional HMM, persistence is encoded implicitly in the diagonal elements of the transition matrix 𝐴. A large value of 𝑎 𝑖𝑖 indicates that regime 𝑖 tends to persist, but this representation captures only one-step persistence-the probability of remaining in the state at the next instant. It does not represent the cumulative temporal probability mass generated by remaining there. Under the HMM, regime 𝑆 𝑡 evolves according to 𝐴, with implied expected spell length 𝔼[𝜏 𝑖 ] = 1∕(1-𝑎 𝑖𝑖). If 𝑎 𝑖𝑖 = 1, residence time becomes infinite and the process becomes structurally non-ergodic. Treating conditional persistence as permanence replaces stochastic dwell time with deterministic residence, suppressing regime uncertainty and hazard. In Talebian terms, conditional persistence is survival-compatible, whereas assumed permanence is ruincompatible. The COR framework resolves this limitation by introducing an exit parameter 𝜀 ∈ (0, 1), 𝑄 = (1-𝜀)𝐴, which converts the HMM into a transient system. This yields the fundamental matrix 𝑉 (1) = (𝐼-𝑄)-1 , integrating expected state occupancy across the entire future horizon. COR therefore transforms transition probabilities into temporal mass, making regime duration and exposure structurally observable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Clock of Regimes (COR)模型，这是一种新的状态转换模型，通过引入退出参数ε将传统隐马尔可夫模型转换为瞬态系统，从而解决了HMM中状态持续性仅表示一步概率而无法捕捉累积时间概率质量的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何解决传统隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)中状态持续性仅编码为一步转移概率，而无法表示状态持续时间的累积概率质量的问题？
AI.motivation: 传统HMM中，状态的持续性仅通过转移矩阵的对角元素隐式编码，这种表示只捕捉了一步持续性概率，无法反映状态停留时间的累积概率质量。当a_ii=1时，停留时间变为无限，过程变得结构非遍历，将条件持续性视为永久性会抑制状态不确定性和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)理论；2. 状态转换模型理论；3. 遍历性理论；4. 基本矩阵理论；5. Taleb的风险理论框架（生存兼容vs毁灭兼容）
AI.method: 提出Clock of Regimes (COR)模型，引入退出参数ε∈(0,1)，定义Q=(1-ε)A，将HMM转换为瞬态系统，从而得到基本矩阵V(1)=(I-Q)^{-1}，该矩阵整合了整个未来时间范围内的期望状态占用。
AI.findings: COR框架通过引入退出参数ε，将转移概率转换为时间质量，使状态持续时间和暴露在结构上可观测。该模型解决了HMM中条件持续性被错误视为永久性的问题，将状态转换过程从仅关注一步概率扩展到整个时间维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了新的状态转换模型类别，具有N=-K-1算子；2. 将HMM转换为瞬态系统，使状态持续时间结构可观测；3. 解决了HMM中条件持续性仅表示一步概率的局限性；4. 建立了转移概率与时间质量之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融风险管理、经济周期分析等领域提供了更准确的状态持续时间建模工具；2. 使决策者能够更好地评估状态暴露风险；3. 提高了对状态转换过程中不确定性的量化能力；4. 为处理结构非遍历性问题提供了新方法。

title: The Effects of Disability and Caregiving on Work and Perceptions of Economic Insecurity in Sweden, Italy, Germany, and the UK
affiliations: University of Toronto and University of Alberta - Department of Sociology

detail.title: The Effects of Disability and Caregiving on Work and Perceptions of Economic Insecurity in Sweden, Italy, Germany, and the UK
detail.abstract: Disability is associated with a range of structural disadvantages facing individuals and households alike. Drawing from a recent online cross-national survey of Germany, Italy, Sweden, and the UK, we explore the relationships between disability, caregiving, employment, and perceived economic insecurity. We examine whether having a household member with disabilities increases the likelihood of caregiving, and whether both disability and caregiving shape employment outcomes as well as perceptions of economic insecurity. In addition to nding that people with disabilities are less likely to work, we also nd that individuals living in households with a disabled member are signi cantly more likely to engage in caregiving activities, which contributes to reduced employment. As a result, households that included a member with a disability tended to experience greater economic insecurity. We also nd that instances of providing care and perceptions of economic insecurity are comparatively greater in Italy. Together, these ndings point to important family and caregiving dynamics and their relationship to work and feelings of economic security in different policy contexts.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于德国、意大利、瑞典和英国的跨国在线调查，探讨了残疾、照护、就业与经济不安全感知之间的关系。研究发现：残疾人就业率较低；与残疾人同住的家庭成员更可能提供照护，从而减少就业；有残疾成员的家庭经济不安全感更强；意大利的照护负担和经济不安全感尤为突出。
AI.research_question: 残疾、照护责任如何影响就业结果和经济不安全感知？与残疾人同住是否会增加照护活动，进而影响就业和经济安全？不同国家政策背景下这些关系有何差异？
AI.motivation: 残疾与个人和家庭面临的结构性劣势相关，但残疾、照护、就业和经济不安全之间的具体关系机制尚需跨国比较研究，特别是在不同福利政策背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构性劣势理论、家庭照护负担理论、就业障碍理论，以及福利国家比较框架，探讨残疾相关的多重劣势如何在家庭层面交织影响。
AI.method: 采用德国、意大利、瑞典和英国的跨国在线调查数据，进行定量分析，检验残疾状况、照护活动、就业结果和经济不安全感知之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 残疾人就业可能性较低；2) 与残疾人同住的家庭成员更可能提供照护，照护责任减少就业；3) 有残疾成员的家庭经济不安全感更强；4) 意大利的照护负担和经济不安全感尤为突出，显示政策背景的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 阐明了残疾、照护和就业之间的连锁效应机制；2) 揭示了家庭层面的残疾相关劣势传递路径；3) 验证了福利国家政策在调节这些关系中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供证据，支持发展更全面的残疾人家庭支持体系；2) 强调需要减轻照护者的就业障碍；3) 指出意大利等国家需要特别关注照护负担和经济安全政策。

title: Retail Order Flow Segmentation, Price Improvements, and Market Quality: Evidence from Xetra Retail
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt Faculty of Economics and Business Administration,  and Goethe University Frankfurt Faculty of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: Retail Order Flow Segmentation, Price Improvements, and Market Quality: Evidence from Xetra Retail
detail.abstract: Exchanges worldwide are introducing on-exchange retail programs that segment retail order flow within lit markets and compete with off-exchange internalization and payment-for-order-flow models. Despite their rapid adoption, little causal evidence exists on whether such mechanisms can improve retail execution without harming market quality. We study the introduction of the Xetra Retail Service (XR), which enables retail orders to interact with competing Retail Liquidity Providers (RLPs). Retail orders are executed against RLPs that offer price improvements over displayed quotes or in the regular limit order book. We use granular ETF trading data in a difference-indifferences design (control: Euronext Milan) to assess execution outcomes and market quality effects. We find that 63% of retail ETF trades receive price improvement, averaging 0.93 bps (1.35 bps conditional). As expected, improvements are larger when spreads are wider and volatility is higher. Unexpectedly, price improvements are more likely for larger orders. At the overall market quality level, spreads, activity, and volatility remain stable, though displayed depth declines modestly. Overall, on-exchange retail segmentation can enhance retail execution without impairing market quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了德国交易所推出的Xetra零售服务（XR），发现该机制能为63%的零售ETF交易提供价格改善（平均0.93个基点），且不影响整体市场质量。
AI.research_question: 交易所推出的零售订单流分割机制（如Xetra零售服务）能否改善零售执行质量而不损害市场质量？
AI.motivation: 全球交易所正在引入场内零售项目，与场外内部化和订单流付费模式竞争，但这些机制对零售执行质量和市场质量的影响缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、订单流分割理论、零售执行质量与市场质量权衡理论。
AI.method: 使用ETF交易数据，采用双重差分法（DID）设计，以米兰泛欧交易所作为对照组，分析执行结果和市场质量效应。
AI.findings: 63%的零售ETF交易获得价格改善，平均0.93个基点（有条件情况下1.35个基点）；价差越大、波动性越高时改善更大；意外发现大额订单更可能获得价格改善；整体市场质量稳定，但显示深度略有下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为场内零售订单流分割机制提供了因果证据，证明了零售执行改善与市场质量可以共存，挑战了传统认为两者必须权衡的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所设计零售服务提供实证支持，表明场内零售分割机制可以替代场外内部化模式，为监管机构制定零售投资者保护政策提供参考。

title: Smith Meets Schumpeter: Market Size, the Division of Labor and Creative Destruction
affiliations: Jiaxing University and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Smith Meets Schumpeter: Market Size, the Division of Labor and Creative Destruction
detail.abstract: This paper develops a growth model that integrates Smithian division of labor with Schumpeterian growth. The key departure from standard quality-ladder models is that the depth of task specialization within firms enters the arrival rate of innovations, creating an organizational channel from market scale to growth beyond the standard channel operating through R&D intensity. Population enters the model only through an aggregate labor constraint, and the Smithian effectlarger markets support finer specialization-emerges from general-equilibrium adjustment alone. A balanced growth path is characterized and its stability is examined. The growth-scale elasticity is decomposed into a direct R&D channel and an organizational channel, and a substantial share of the scale effect is shown to be accounted for by the organizational channel. Quantitatively, the model implies a superlinear growth response to market size, with a substantial share of the scale effect operating through organization rather than R&D alone. At baseline calibration, doubling market scale raises the long-run growth rate from 0.76% to 1.66%, with roughly one-third of the total growth-scale response flowing through the organizational channel. Reducing coordination costs by one-third raises growth by approximately 24%, with convex effects.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个结合斯密式劳动分工和熊彼特式增长的增长模型，其中企业内部任务专业化的深度影响创新率，创造了一个从市场规模到增长的组织渠道，超越了标准的研发强度渠道。
AI.research_question: 市场规模如何通过组织渠道（任务专业化深度）影响长期经济增长，而不仅仅是传统的研发强度渠道？
AI.motivation: 传统质量阶梯模型主要关注研发强度作为市场规模影响增长的唯一渠道，忽略了企业内部组织结构和任务专业化对创新的影响。需要整合斯密的分工理论和熊彼特的创新理论，以更全面地理解市场扩张如何促进经济增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合斯密（Adam Smith）的劳动分工理论和熊彼特（Joseph Schumpeter）的创新驱动增长理论，构建了一个包含组织渠道的增长模型。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建内生增长模型，将任务专业化深度作为创新到达率的决定因素。分析平衡增长路径及其稳定性，分解增长-规模弹性为直接研发渠道和组织渠道，并进行定量校准分析。
AI.findings: 1. 模型显示增长对市场规模的响应是超线性的；2. 组织渠道解释了约三分之一的增长-规模效应；3. 在基准校准下，市场规模翻倍使长期增长率从0.76%提高到1.66%；4. 协调成本降低三分之一可使增长提高约24%，且存在凸性效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将斯密式分工深度整合到熊彼特式增长模型中；2. 识别并量化了从市场规模到增长的组织渠道；3. 提供了增长-规模弹性的新分解框架；4. 扩展了对市场扩张促进增长机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了通过降低协调成本促进增长的新视角；2. 强调了组织设计和任务专业化在创新政策中的重要性；3. 量化了市场规模扩张对增长的实际影响；4. 为企业优化内部组织结构以提高创新效率提供了理论依据。

title:
Capital Market Signals and the Risk of K-Shaped Economic Development in Ghana 
A Macroeconomic Outlook for the Next One to Two Years

detail.title:
Capital Market Signals and the Risk of K-Shaped Economic Development in Ghana 
A Macroeconomic Outlook for the Next One to Two Years
detail.abstract:
Recent developments on the Ghanaian capital market have attracted considerable attention. The strong rally of equities and the historic rise of the GSE Composite Index suggest growing investor confidence in the country's macroeconomic outlook. Because financial markets are forward-looking, such movements may signal expectations of economic stabilisation and recovery following the financial crisis associated with Ghana's sovereign debt restructuring. 
However, the stock market represents only a small segment of Ghana's economic structure. This raises an important analytical question: does the recent capital-market boom indicate broadbased economic recovery, or could it reflect the early emergence of a K-shaped economic development in which large corporations and capital-intensive sectors recover faster than the broader productive economy? 
This paper examines the macroeconomic signals embedded in the recent stock-market rally and discusses the structural conditions that could lead to uneven economic recovery in Ghana over the next one to two years.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加纳股市繁荣是否预示广泛经济复苏，还是反映了K型经济复苏的早期迹象，即大型企业和资本密集型行业比更广泛的生产经济恢复更快。
AI.research_question: 加纳近期的资本市场繁荣是否表明广泛的经济复苏，还是反映了K型经济发展的早期迹象（大型企业和资本密集型行业比更广泛的生产经济恢复更快）？
AI.motivation: 加纳股市近期强劲上涨和GSE综合指数历史性上升表明投资者对宏观经济前景信心增强，但股市仅代表加纳经济结构的一小部分，需要分析这是否预示着广泛经济复苏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融市场前瞻性理论、K型经济发展理论、经济复苏不平衡理论、资本市场与实体经济关系理论。
AI.method: 分析嵌入在近期股市繁荣中的宏观经济信号，讨论可能导致加纳未来1-2年经济复苏不平衡的结构性条件。
AI.findings: 论文将探讨加纳股市繁荣与实体经济复苏之间的关系，分析是否存在K型经济复苏模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家特别是非洲国家的资本市场与实体经济关系研究提供理论贡献，深化对K型经济复苏模式的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳政策制定者提供关于经济复苏性质的见解，帮助识别和应对不平衡复苏风险，为投资者提供更准确的市场信号解读。

title: Evidence Based Financial Planning -Target Date 2040 To 2050? Wow that Long? That's a Whole Generation from Now!

detail.title: Evidence Based Financial Planning -Target Date 2040 To 2050? Wow that Long? That's a Whole Generation from Now!

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No relationships.
declarations.funderStatement: Self funded.

detail.abstract:
This working paper explores the systemic evolution of Personal Financial Planning (PFP) from a consensus-based discipline into a rigorous, Evidence-Based Financial Planning (EBFP) profession. By modeling its development after the 50-year history of Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM), the text proposes a standardized five-step workflow—Ask, Acquire, Appraise, Apply, and Assess—designed to replace traditional "rules of thumb" with scientifically validated data.

The analysis situates the current state of PFP in an "adolescent" stage, approximately 30 to 40 years behind the medical profession’s maturity. It identifies key institutional milestones, such as the need for a "Financial Cochrane" to synthesize research and the transition from "eminence-based" expert opinion to "process-based" systematic reviews. Technical challenges are also addressed, specifically the limitations of backtesting compared to medical Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) and the impact of the Lucas Critique on financial modeling.

Finally, the paper examines the intersection of EBFP and the aging process, advocating for a shift from "Sports Performance" (accumulation) to "Geriatric Medicine" (decumulation). It highlights the risks of Financial Anosognosia—the gap between stable financial confidence and declining cognitive fluid intelligence—and introduces the concept of Synchronized Exhaustion to coordinate Wealthspans with remaining Lifespans. The author concludes by outlining a research agenda focused on withdrawal sequencing, biomarker-driven planning, and psychological interventions to address the "Retirement Savings Puzzle."

This paper supplements its companion piece* to function as preliminary, exploratory working papers designed to identify, gather, and condense the foundational concepts and current developmental status of Evidence-Based Financial Planning (EBFP). These efforts serve as an iterative stage of research, intended to synthesize emerging theories and institutional milestones for eventual consolidation into a comprehensive and formal research paper. * Frank Sr, Larry R., A Profession in Search of a Theory: Bridging the Research-Practice Divide to Establish Evidence-Based Planning for the Financial Planning Profession (January 28, 2026). Available at SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6263638 or http://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6263638

AI.tldr: 该工作论文探讨个人财务规划(PFP)如何从共识性学科演变为严谨的循证财务规划(EBFP)专业，借鉴循证医学50年发展经验，提出五步标准化工作流程，并分析PFP当前处于"青春期"阶段，落后医学30-40年，重点关注老龄化过程中的财务规划挑战。
AI.research_question: 个人财务规划如何从基于共识的学科转变为严谨的循证专业？循证财务规划的发展路径、面临的挑战以及如何应对老龄化社会的财务规划需求？
AI.motivation: 个人财务规划领域缺乏科学严谨性，过度依赖传统"经验法则"而非实证证据，需要建立类似循证医学的标准化体系，特别是在老龄化社会背景下，需要更科学的财务规划方法来应对认知衰退和财富管理挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循证医学理论框架、制度发展理论、认知心理学（财务失认症）、生命周期理论（财富跨度与寿命同步）、卢卡斯批判对金融建模的影响。
AI.method: 比较分析方法（将PFP与EBM发展历程对比）、概念建模（五步工作流程）、制度分析（识别关键里程碑）、理论推导（从医学到财务规划的跨学科应用）。
AI.findings: 1. PFP处于"青春期"发展阶段，落后医学30-40年；2. 需要建立"财务科克伦"机构来综合研究；3. 从"权威导向"转向"流程导向"的系统评价；4. 回测方法相比医学RCT存在局限性；5. 老龄化需要从"运动表现"（积累）转向"老年医学"（提取）模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出循证财务规划的理论框架；2. 引入财务失认症概念；3. 提出同步耗竭理论协调财富跨度与寿命；4. 建立PFP发展阶段的制度演进模型；5. 为"退休储蓄之谜"提供理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供五步标准化工作流程（问、获、评、用、评）；2. 为财务规划专业提供发展路线图；3. 识别老龄化财务规划的具体挑战；4. 提出具体研究议程（提取顺序、生物标志物驱动规划、心理干预）；5. 为行业标准制定提供基础。

title: Beyond Prompting: An Autonomous Framework for Systematic Factor Investing via Agentic AI
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: Beyond Prompting: An Autonomous Framework for Systematic Factor Investing via Agentic AI
detail.abstract: This paper develops an autonomous framework for systematic factor investing via agentic AI. Rather than relying on sequential manual prompts, our approach operationalizes the model as a self-directed engine that endogenously formulates interpretable trading signals. To mitigate data snooping biases, this closed-loop system imposes strict empirical discipline through out-of-sample validation and economic rationale requirements. Applying this methodology to the U.S. equity market, we document that long-short portfolios formed on the simple linear combination of signals deliver an annualized Sharpe ratio of 2.75 and a return of 54.81%. Finally, our empirics demonstrate that self-evolving AI offers a scalable and interpretable paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个通过智能AI进行系统性因子投资的自主框架，该框架将模型作为自驱动引擎，内生地制定可解释的交易信号，并通过样本外验证和经济理性要求来减轻数据窥探偏差，在美国股市应用中实现了年化夏普比率2.75和54.81%的回报。
AI.research_question: 如何通过自主的智能AI框架实现系统性因子投资，内生地制定可解释的交易信号，同时避免数据窥探偏差？
AI.motivation: 传统的因子投资方法通常依赖人工提示和手动操作，存在数据窥探偏差和可扩展性问题，需要开发自主、可解释且具有严格实证纪律的AI驱动框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能AI驱动的自主投资框架、系统性因子投资理论、内生信号生成机制、数据窥探偏差缓解理论。
AI.method: 开发自主的智能AI框架作为自驱动引擎，内生制定可解释交易信号，采用严格的实证纪律包括样本外验证和经济理性要求，应用于美国股市形成多空投资组合。
AI.findings: 基于信号简单线性组合形成的多空投资组合实现了年化夏普比率2.75和54.81%的回报，表明自主演化的AI提供了可扩展且可解释的范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了智能AI驱动的自主因子投资框架理论，发展了内生信号生成机制，为系统性投资提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了可操作的自主AI投资框架，实现了优异的投资绩效，展示了智能AI在金融投资中的实际应用价值。

title: Do Machine Learning Trading Algorithms Trade on Information? Evidence from Investor-type Order Flows and the Probability of Informed Trading

detail.title: Do Machine Learning Trading Algorithms Trade on Information? Evidence from Investor-type Order Flows and the Probability of Informed Trading
detail.abstract: This study examines whether the predictive power of machine learning (ML) algorithms in stock markets originates from informed trading. Using Korean Stock Exchange data covering 729 stocks over 55 quarters (2007-2020), I employ a hierarchical model comparison framework isolating the incremental contribution of investor-type order flow information to ML prediction accuracy. Incorporating investor-type order flow variablesparticularly individual investor order imbalance-significantly improves Random Forest prediction accuracy by 0.27 percentage points (t = 5.97), robust to XGBoost (t = 5.89). This improvement is concentrated in small-cap stocks (+0.57%), 5.7 times larger than in large-cap stocks. Using the Adjusted Probability of Informed Trading (AdjPIN) methodology, I decompose the relationship between ML accuracy and market microstructure: institutional AdjPIN (information asymmetry component) positively predicts ML accuracy (t = 2.83), while the Probability of Symmetric Order-flow Shocks (PSOS; liquidity component) shows no significant relationship. This information channel survives controls for firm size, book-to-market ratio, and industry fixed effects, and holds even when order flow variables are excluded from the ML feature set, ruling out mechanical correlation. A long-short portfolio generates gross annual returns of 26.2% with a Sharpe ratio of 4.51; net returns after transaction costs are negative, consistent with semi-strong market efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨机器学习在股市预测中的能力是否源自知情交易。使用韩国股市数据发现，投资者类型订单流信息（尤其是个体投资者订单失衡）能显著提升机器学习预测准确性，这种提升在小盘股中更明显。机器学习准确性与机构信息不对称成分正相关，而与流动性成分无关。虽然能产生高理论收益，但扣除交易成本后净收益为负，符合半强式有效市场假说。
AI.research_question: 机器学习算法在股票市场中的预测能力是否源自知情交易？
AI.motivation: 机器学习在金融预测中表现出色，但其预测能力的来源尚不明确。理解机器学习预测是否捕捉了市场中的知情交易信息，对于评估市场效率和机器学习模型的实际应用价值至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论，特别是知情交易模型（AdjPIN方法），将市场信息分为信息不对称成分（机构AdjPIN）和流动性成分（PSOS）。同时结合有效市场假说，特别是半强式有效市场理论。
AI.method: 使用韩国证券交易所729只股票55个季度（2007-2020）的数据，采用分层模型比较框架，分离投资者类型订单流信息对机器学习预测准确性的增量贡献。主要使用随机森林和XGBoost算法，并采用调整后的知情交易概率（AdjPIN）方法分解市场微观结构关系。
AI.findings: 1. 投资者类型订单流变量（尤其是个体投资者订单失衡）显著提升机器学习预测准确性0.27个百分点；2. 这种提升在小盘股中更明显（+0.57%），是大盘股的5.7倍；3. 机构AdjPIN（信息不对称成分）正向预测机器学习准确性，而PSOS（流动性成分）无显著关系；4. 长短期投资组合产生26.2%的年化总收益（夏普比率4.51），但扣除交易成本后净收益为负。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地将机器学习预测能力与市场微观结构中的知情交易联系起来；2. 提供了机器学习在金融预测中有效性的理论解释框架；3. 验证了半强式有效市场假说在机器学习预测背景下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了利用机器学习结合订单流信息进行股票预测的具体方法；2. 揭示了小盘股中机器学习预测的更大潜力；3. 提醒投资者注意交易成本对机器学习策略实际收益的影响；4. 为监管机构理解市场信息效率提供了实证证据。

title: Taxation of Material Losses: Thousand Possibilities and One Truth
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Taxation of Material Losses: Thousand Possibilities and One Truth
detail.abstract: This article examines the taxation implications of material losses such as waste, scrap, evaporation, and spoilage in manufacturing processes and the legal controversies that arise when such losses lead to under-production of finished goods. Although material loss is an inevitable aspect of industrial production, tax authorities often treat deviations from prescribed input-output norms as potential indicators of concealed production or tax evasion, thereby raising issues under the Income Tax Act, 2058, the Excise Duty Act, 2002, and the Value Added Tax Act, 2052. Through an analysis of statutory provisions and a range of judicial decisions delivered by the Supreme Court of Nepal and comparative authorities from India, the paper highlights the tension between technical production realities and tax administration. The study demonstrates that courts often emphasize evidentiary standards, the burden of proof on tax authorities, and the need to consider industry conditions before presuming suppression of production. At the same time, inconsistent judicial outcomes and the absence of clear legislative guidance have created uncertainty for taxpayers regarding the treatment of excess material losses. The article ultimately argues for a more coherent legal and administrative framework that balances revenue protection with recognition of genuine operational inefficiencies inherent in manufacturing activities.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨制造业中材料损耗（如废料、蒸发、变质）的税务影响及法律争议，分析当这些损耗导致成品产量不足时引发的税务问题。研究指出税收部门常将偏离投入产出标准视为潜在逃税迹象，但法院强调证据标准、举证责任和行业实际情况的重要性。文章主张建立更协调的法律框架，平衡税收保护与制造业固有运营效率问题。
AI.research_question: 制造业中的材料损耗（如废料、蒸发、变质）如何影响税收合规，以及当这些损耗导致成品产量不足时，法律应如何平衡税收保护与制造业实际运营效率？
AI.motivation: 材料损耗是制造业不可避免的现象，但税收部门常将偏离投入产出标准视为潜在逃税迹象，导致法律争议。这种技术生产现实与税收管理之间的紧张关系需要系统分析，以解决纳税人的不确定性和司法不一致问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税法理论（特别是所得税法、消费税法和增值税法），结合证据法原则（举证责任、证据标准），以及制造业运营效率理论，分析材料损耗的税务处理与司法审查标准。
AI.method: 采用法律分析方法，研究尼泊尔《所得税法2058》、《消费税法案2002》和《增值税法2052》的法定条款，分析尼泊尔最高法院的司法判例，并与印度相关权威案例进行对比研究。
AI.findings: 1. 法院通常强调税收部门需承担举证责任，证明材料损耗异常构成逃税；2. 司法判决要求考虑行业实际条件和运营效率，而非简单依据投入产出偏差；3. 司法结果存在不一致性，缺乏明确立法指导导致纳税人面临不确定性；4. 技术生产现实与税收管理之间存在持续紧张关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统分析了制造业材料损耗的税法理论框架；2. 明确了司法审查中证据标准和举证责任的重要性；3. 提出了平衡税收保护与运营效率的理论基础；4. 为税法与制造业实践交叉研究提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为纳税人提供了材料损耗税务处理的实践指导；2. 为税收部门提供了更合理的执法参考；3. 建议建立更协调的法律和行政框架；4. 为立法者提供了明确材料损耗税务处理的政策建议；5. 有助于减少司法不一致性，提高税收确定性。

title: Conceptual Relativity in Urban Eco-Economic Dynamics: A Spatial Stock-Flow Consistent Agent-Based Model for France, Germany, Spain, and Italy (2000-2025)
affiliations: University of Ain Temouchent

detail.title: Conceptual Relativity in Urban Eco-Economic Dynamics: A Spatial Stock-Flow Consistent Agent-Based Model for France, Germany, Spain, and Italy (2000-2025)
detail.abstract: This paper develops a Spatial Stock-Flow Consistent Agent-Based Model (SFC-ABM) to analyze urban eco-economic dynamics under the lens of conceptual relativity, defined as the idea that economic and environmental constraints are mediated by socially constructed perceptions rather than being uniformly interpreted across agents and places. Focusing on urban systems in France, Germany, Spain, and Italy over the period 2000-2025, the model integrates macro-financial accounting consistency, heterogeneous agent behavior, explicit spatial structure, and endogenous perception dynamics. The framework captures the co-evolution of four interdependent domains: the economy (income, employment, investment, and debt), the environment (emissions, environmental quality, and ecological stocks), institutions (fiscal capacity, policy credibility, and trust), and perceptions (environmental concern, risk awareness, and life satisfaction). Agents' perceptions evolve through social interaction, institutional feedback, and local environmental outcomes, shaping consumption, mobility, green investment, and political support for policy. By embedding these cognitive processes within a stock-flow consistent macro structure, the model links belief formation to financial constraints and long-run sustainability. Simulation results highlight that countries exposed to similar regulatory frameworks can follow markedly different urban sustainability trajectories due to differences in institutional trust, segregation, and perception heterogeneity. High trust and shared environmental narratives foster more effective green investment and virtuous eco-economic cycles, while fragmented perceptions and low credibility generate policy resistance, spatial divergence, and weaker environmental outcomes. The findings demonstrate that ignoring perception heterogeneity leads to systematic bias in policy evaluation, overstating the effectiveness of uniform climate and urban policies. Overall, the paper contributes a unified modeling architecture that bridges macro-financial realism, spatial ecology, and behavioral heterogeneity. It shows that successful urban sustainability transitions are not only technological or fiscal challenges, but also coordination problems rooted in perception, legitimacy, and social cohesion.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个空间存量-流量一致的基于代理模型，分析城市生态经济动态，强调经济与环境约束是通过社会建构的感知来调节的，而非统一解释。模型整合了宏观金融会计一致性、异质代理行为、显式空间结构和内生感知动态，模拟了经济、环境、制度和感知四个领域的协同演化。
AI.research_question: 在概念相对性框架下，社会建构的感知如何调节城市生态经济动态，以及感知异质性如何影响不同国家在相似监管框架下的城市可持续发展轨迹？
AI.motivation: 传统政策评估往往忽略感知异质性，假设经济与环境约束被统一解释，导致对统一气候和城市政策有效性的系统性高估。需要开发一个能整合宏观金融现实、空间生态和行为异质性的统一建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念相对性理论（经济与环境约束通过社会建构的感知调节）、存量-流量一致性理论、基于代理建模理论、空间生态经济学、行为经济学中的感知形成理论。
AI.method: 开发空间存量-流量一致的基于代理模型，整合宏观金融会计一致性、异质代理行为、显式空间结构和内生感知动态。模型应用于法国、德国、西班牙和意大利的城市系统（2000-2025年），模拟经济、环境、制度和感知四个领域的协同演化。
AI.findings: 1. 暴露于相似监管框架的国家可能因制度信任、隔离和感知异质性的差异而遵循显著不同的城市可持续发展轨迹；2. 高信任和共享环境叙事促进更有效的绿色投资和良性生态经济循环；3. 碎片化感知和低可信度导致政策抵制、空间分化和较弱的环境结果；4. 忽略感知异质性会导致政策评估的系统性偏差，高估统一政策的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了概念相对性作为分析城市生态经济动态的新视角；2. 开发了统一建模架构，桥接宏观金融现实主义、空间生态学和行为异质性；3. 将感知形成过程嵌入存量-流量一致的宏观结构中，连接信念形成与财务约束及长期可持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了成功的城市可持续转型不仅是技术或财政挑战，更是植根于感知、合法性和社会凝聚力的协调问题；2. 为政策制定者提供了考虑感知异质性的政策设计框架；3. 强调了制度信任和环境叙事在促进有效绿色投资中的关键作用；4. 提供了评估政策有效性的更准确方法，避免系统性偏差。

title: Do LLMs Make Markets More Efficient?
affiliations: University of Toronto, Monash University and University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Rady School of Management, Students

detail.title: Do LLMs Make Markets More Efficient?
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether large language models (LLMs) improve or impair market efficiency. Exploiting plausibly exogenous outages at major LLM providers, we find that LLM availability eliminates at least 46% to 61% of post-news drift into the next trading day. The absence of reversal alongside the magnitude of this reduction suggests that LLMs play a first-order role in short-horizon price discovery. Because LLM supply is highly concentrated, outages expose a single point of failure in marketwide information processing. Consistent with this interpretation, investors insulated from major LLM outages can earn more than twice the day t + 1 returns of the longshort news-sentiment strategy following outage events.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过分析大型语言模型（LLM）提供商的服务中断事件，发现LLM可用性消除了46%-61%的新闻后漂移，表明LLM在短期价格发现中起关键作用。由于LLM供应高度集中，中断暴露了市场信息处理的单点故障风险。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是改善还是损害了市场效率？
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在金融分析中的广泛应用，需要评估其对市场效率的实际影响，特别是考虑到LLM供应高度集中可能带来的系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论、信息处理理论和价格发现理论，探讨LLMs如何影响市场对新信息的反应速度和准确性。
AI.method: 利用主要LLM提供商的服务中断作为准自然实验，分析中断期间和正常期间市场对新闻反应模式的差异，特别是新闻后漂移现象。
AI.findings: 1. LLM可用性消除了46%-61%的新闻后漂移到下一个交易日；2. 没有观察到反转现象，表明LLM在短期价格发现中起关键作用；3. 未受主要LLM中断影响的投资者可获得超过两倍的t+1日新闻情绪策略回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证证明LLMs在金融市场信息处理中的重要作用；2. 揭示了LLM供应集中化对市场效率的系统性风险；3. 为理解人工智能技术如何影响市场微观结构提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒监管机构关注LLM集中化带来的系统性风险；2. 为投资者提供利用LLM中断事件获取超额回报的策略；3. 为金融机构评估AI技术依赖风险提供实证依据。

title: Impact Preferences in Sustainable Investing: Theory and Experiment
affiliations: University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics

detail.title: Impact Preferences in Sustainable Investing: Theory and Experiment
detail.abstract: Sustainable investing is widespread, yet investors' motives are not well understood. Are they driven by a desire to generate environmental impact (impact preferences) or by a preference to invest in firms that share their values (value alignment)? To distinguish these motives, I conduct an experiment with U.S. investors, eliciting their willingness to pay for investments in firms that vary only in environmental impact. The experimental design varies (i) participants' pivotality in changing the firm's externalities and (ii) the firm's current level of externalities. These variations allow me to distinguish impact preferences from value alignment, and to examine whether participants value a firm's current level of externalities independently of the investment impact. My main finding is that for investments that generate the same positive impact, participants prefer those that help firms transition from negative to positive externalities. Structural estimates indicate that this behavioral pattern is driven by two forces: an asymmetry in how participants value positive versus negative externalities, and diminishing sensitivity to externality size. Contrary to previous evidence, participants are motivated primarily by impact preferences rather than value alignment.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验区分投资者可持续投资的动机：是追求环境影响力（impact preferences）还是价值观一致性（value alignment）。研究发现，投资者主要受影响力偏好驱动，且偏好帮助企业从负面外部性转向正面外部性的投资。
AI.research_question: 投资者进行可持续投资的主要动机是什么？是追求环境影响力（impact preferences）还是寻求价值观一致性（value alignment）？
AI.motivation: 可持续投资虽然普遍，但投资者的真实动机尚未被充分理解。区分影响力偏好和价值观一致性对于理解可持续投资行为至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和可持续投资理论，区分两种动机：影响力偏好（追求实际环境改善）和价值观一致性（投资与个人价值观相符的企业）。
AI.method: 对美国投资者进行实验设计，通过改变两个关键变量来区分动机：（1）参与者在改变企业外部性中的关键性（pivotality）；（2）企业当前的外部性水平。
AI.findings: 主要发现：对于产生相同正面影响力的投资，投资者更偏好帮助企业从负面外部性转向正面外部性的投资。结构估计表明这一行为模式由两个因素驱动：对正负外部性评价的不对称性，以及对外部性规模的敏感性递减。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了先前关于投资者主要受价值观一致性驱动的证据，证明影响力偏好是可持续投资的主要动机。提出了区分两种动机的实验方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理公司设计可持续投资产品提供指导，帮助理解投资者真实偏好。为企业改善环境表现提供激励，特别是从负面转向正面的转型过程。

title: Mortgage Lock-In as Inventory Suppression: Evidence of Causal Reversal in U.S. Housing Markets, 2018-2024
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Mortgage Lock-In as Inventory Suppression: Evidence of Causal Reversal in U.S. Housing Markets, 2018-2024
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the Federal Reserve's 2022 rate hike cycle structurally altered the causal relationship between housing inventory and prices in U.S. metropolitan markets. The analysis proceeds in four stages. A descriptive analysis with unit root testing, two-way panel fixed effects, VAR/Granger causality with impulse response functions, and difference-indifferences , applied to a panel of 50 major U.S. metro areas from January 2018 through December 2024 (4,200 metro-month observations). Pre-2022, inventory Granger-causes prices (p = 0.014) but prices do not Granger-cause inventory (p = 0.199), consistent with the conventional supply-demand narrative. Post-2022, a statistically significant price-to-inventory feedback channel emerges at lag-1 (p = 0.018) that was absent pre-2022 (p = 0.376). Homeowners holding sub-3% mortgages who face rates exceeding 7% have no financial incentive to sell, and elevated prices reinforce that decision rather than stimulate new listings. High-exposure metros experienced approximately 0.22 percentage points per month slower real price growth post-2022 (DiD β3 =-0.0022, p = 0.054). Standard monetary transmission models and supply-side affordability projections require revision when a large stock of rate-locked mortgages exists. The findings imply that standard monetary transmission models overestimate supply responsiveness when a large stock of rate-locked mortgages exists, that affordability projections must treat inventory as endogenous to prices, and that durable relief requires supply-side interventions independent of the rate environment.

AI.tldr: 美联储2022年加息周期改变了美国住房市场库存与价格之间的因果关系，从单向的库存影响价格转变为双向反馈机制，主要原因是大量房主被低利率抵押贷款锁定不愿出售。
AI.research_question: 美联储2022年加息周期是否结构性改变了美国大都市住房市场中库存与价格之间的因果关系？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策变化如何影响住房市场动态，特别是当大量房主被低利率抵押贷款锁定时，传统的供需模型可能失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统供需理论、货币政策传导机制、格兰杰因果关系、利率锁定效应、住房市场动态调整理论。
AI.method: 使用2018年1月至2024年12月美国50个主要大都市区的面板数据（4,200个观测值），进行描述性分析、单位根检验、双向面板固定效应、VAR/格兰杰因果关系与脉冲响应函数、双重差分法。
AI.findings: 1. 2022年前：库存格兰杰导致价格（p=0.014），但价格不导致库存（p=0.199），符合传统供需叙事。2. 2022年后：出现显著的价格到库存反馈渠道（p=0.018），而此前不存在（p=0.376）。3. 高暴露都市区在2022年后实际价格增长每月慢约0.22个百分点（DiD β3=-0.0022，p=0.054）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了利率锁定效应如何改变住房市场动态。2. 表明当存在大量利率锁定抵押贷款时，标准货币政策传导模型高估了供给响应性。3. 提出库存应被视为价格的内生变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者需要修订货币政策传导模型和可负担性预测。2. 住房市场干预需要独立于利率环境的供给侧措施。3. 为理解当前住房市场僵局提供实证依据。

title: Do Options Markets Anticipate Momentum Breakout Failures?

detail.title: Do Options Markets Anticipate Momentum Breakout Failures?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and sole principal of Systematic Equity Strategies, LLC, which operates the momentum breakout strategy described in this paper. The backtest trade data used in the analysis was generated by the author's proprietary backtest engine. The author has a financial interest in the commercial success of the strategy. No external funding was received for this research. The decision to investigate options-based entry filters was motivated by a genuine interest in improving the strategy's performance; the null result reported here was not the anticipated outcome.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available historical market data and does not involve human subjects, patients, or participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author through Systematic Equity Strategies, LLC. No external grants, sponsorships, or third-party funding were received. Options market data was obtained through a commercial subscription to the Polygon.io API.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper has not been submitted or accepted for publication at this time.

detail.abstract: A substantial body of academic literature establishes that options market signals — implied volatility spreads, volatility skew, and put-call volume ratios — predict future equity returns. These signals are theorized to reflect informed trading by sophisticated market participants who prefer options for their leverage and anonymity. We test whether these signals can be applied as pre-entry filters for a systematic momentum strategy that buys S&P 500 stocks making 252-day price highs. Using 672 round-trip trades from a ten-year backtest (2014–2025), we compute implied volatility and volume metrics from historical option prices on each entry date. No metric achieves statistical significance for predicting trade direction, return magnitude, quintile rank, or tail loss severity (all p > 0.19, Cohen's d < 0.13, Pearson |r| < 0.05, multivariate R² = 0.005). A Monte Carlo analysis reveals that individual filters' Sharpe improvements slightly exceed random removal benchmarks, suggesting a weak effect — but this effect does not survive composite application, does not reduce average loss severity, and is confounded by differential sample composition. We conclude that the cross-sectional predictive power of options signals documented in the academic literature does not survive conditioning on 252-day breakouts in S&P 500 large-cap equities.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了期权市场信号（隐含波动率价差、波动率偏斜、买卖权成交量比率）作为动量策略入场前过滤器的有效性，发现在S&P 500大盘股252日突破条件下，这些信号没有统计显著的预测能力。
AI.research_question: 期权市场信号能否作为系统性动量策略的入场前过滤器，有效预测S&P 500股票252日价格突破后的未来收益？
AI.motivation: 学术文献表明期权市场信号能预测股票收益，这些信号被认为反映了知情交易者的行为。但现有研究未检验这些信号在特定交易策略（如动量策略）条件下的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 期权市场信号理论：隐含波动率价差、波动率偏斜、买卖权成交量比率反映知情交易；2) 动量策略理论：买入创252日新高的股票；3) 信息不对称理论：知情交易者偏好期权的杠杆和匿名性。
AI.method: 1) 十年回测（2014-2025），672次往返交易；2) 在每次入场日期计算历史期权价格的隐含波动率和成交量指标；3) 统计检验：预测交易方向、收益幅度、五分位排名、尾部损失严重性；4) 蒙特卡洛分析评估夏普比率改进。
AI.findings: 所有期权指标均无统计显著性（p>0.19，Cohen's d<0.13，Pearson |r|<0.05，多元R²=0.005）。单个过滤器对夏普比率的改进略高于随机移除基准，但复合应用时效果消失，且不能降低平均损失严重性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了期权市场信号的预测能力存在条件依赖性；2) 表明学术文献中发现的横截面预测能力在特定交易策略条件下可能失效；3) 对信息不对称理论在实践应用中的局限性提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提醒交易者不应盲目将学术文献中的期权信号应用于实际动量策略；2) 表明在S&P 500大盘股的252日突破策略中，期权信号作为入场过滤器无效；3) 为量化投资策略开发提供了实证参考。

title: The Triad: A Canonical Declaration on Governance-Grade Readiness, Recognition, and Valuation
affiliations: Fintech Founder

detail.title: The Triad: A Canonical Declaration on Governance-Grade Readiness, Recognition, and Valuation
detail.abstract:
Modern financial infrastructure, particularly real‑time payments, stablecoins, tokenized deposits, and digitally native settlement rails, have advanced faster than the governance language required to determine when such capabilities are ready to be recognized, expanded, or valued responsibly. As a result, institutions increasingly face a false choice between premature recognition driven by technological feasibility and institutional paralysis driven by disclosure, supervisory, and valuation risk.

This Canonical Declaration introduces the Triad: a governance‑grade decision architecture composed of three deliberately non‑enabling layers: Evidence Coverage, Recognition Gating, and Valuation Discipline. The Triad is not a method, model, or tool. It is a canonical language for sequencing governance decisions under uncertainty, designed to preserve institutional judgment, supervisory discretion, and financial integrity.

The Triad is intended to function as a governing text that precedes open‑source vocabulary releases, pilot engagements, and future multi‑institutional stewardship, without implying regulatory pre‑commitment, safe harbors, or ex ante approval of any technology, instrument, or operating model.

Notes on IP & Marks: Tokenized Decade™, TVP™, R Gate™, and ECF are used as conceptual identifiers. This public draft is strictly non-enabling and discloses no protected implementation. No license is granted or implied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"三元架构"作为治理级决策框架，包含证据覆盖、认可门控和价值纪律三个非赋能层，旨在为金融机构在数字金融基础设施快速发展背景下提供治理决策语言，避免过早认可或制度瘫痪的二元困境。
AI.research_question: 在数字金融基础设施（实时支付、稳定币、代币化存款等）快速发展但治理语言滞后的背景下，金融机构如何建立有效的治理决策框架，避免在技术可行性和制度风险之间做出错误选择？
AI.motivation: 现代金融基础设施（特别是实时支付、稳定币、代币化存款和数字原生结算系统）的发展速度超过了治理语言的发展，导致机构面临"过早认可技术可行性"和"因披露、监管、估值风险而制度瘫痪"之间的错误选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元架构理论：由三个非赋能层组成的治理级决策架构：1) 证据覆盖层，2) 认可门控层，3) 价值纪律层。该框架强调在不确定性下序列化治理决策，保持机构判断力、监管自由裁量权和金融完整性。
AI.method: 规范性框架构建方法：通过提出"三元架构"作为治理文本和规范语言，为治理决策提供结构化框架。该方法不是具体模型或工具，而是决策架构和语言系统。
AI.findings: 三元架构能够为金融机构提供治理决策的规范语言，帮助机构在数字金融创新中做出负责任的决策，同时避免监管预先承诺、安全港或事前技术批准等隐含承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出治理级决策架构理论；2) 建立不确定性下治理决策序列化理论；3) 为非赋能治理框架提供理论基础；4) 为数字金融治理语言发展做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为金融机构提供治理决策实用框架；2) 支持开源词汇发布前的治理文本；3) 促进试点参与和多机构管理；4) 保持监管自由裁量权同时推动创新；5) 避免过早技术认可或制度瘫痪的实践困境。

title: Fast Payment Systems and Deposit Dynamics: Evidence from Brazil's Pix
affiliations: FGV-EBAPE, Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) and Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Brazilian School of Public and Business Administration (EBAPE)

detail.title: Fast Payment Systems and Deposit Dynamics: Evidence from Brazil's Pix
detail.abstract: Deposits are the foundation of bank funding and financial stability. We investigate how Brazil's instant payment system, Pix, reshapes deposit dynamics. Pix, launched by the Central Bank of Brazil in November 2020, enables real-time transfers 24/7 at minimal cost. Using monthly bank-municipality panel data from 2010-2025, we examine how Pix changes bank deposit levels and their volatility. We take advantage of three important features of Pix that facilitate identification. First, participation in Pix was mandatory for large banks, making the reform exogenous to bank characteristics and eliminating selection bias. Second, adoption and usage decisions were made by consumers and firms after launch, generating variation in Pix intensity across banks and municipalities. Third, the shift from traditional payment instruments to instant transfers was unanticipated, creating a quasi-natural experiment in deposit dynamics. First, we find that Pix significantly increases bank deposits, consistent with greater financial inclusion and faster money circulation. Second, Pix increases deposit volatility locally, reflecting faster reallocation of funds across institutions. Third, Pix reduces deposit volatility at the national bank level, suggesting banks benefit from geographic diversification of deposit flows. We validate these findings by analyzing a large temporary shock to public trust in Pix in January 2025 triggered by fake news regarding taxation. During that episode, deposit levels temporarily dropped and their volatility spiked. Overall, our study demonstrates that fast payment innovations significantly transform the way how banks attract and retain deposit funding.

AI.tldr: 巴西即时支付系统Pix显著改变了银行存款动态：增加存款总量、提高地方存款波动性、降低全国银行层面的存款波动性，并通过2025年虚假新闻事件验证了这些发现。
AI.research_question: 巴西即时支付系统Pix如何改变银行存款水平和波动性？
AI.motivation: 存款是银行资金和金融稳定的基础，而Pix作为中央银行推出的即时支付系统，可能从根本上改变存款动态，但具体影响机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、货币流通速度理论、存款竞争理论、地理分散化理论
AI.method: 使用2010-2025年月度银行-城市面板数据，利用Pix的三个特征进行识别：1）大型银行强制参与（外生性）；2）消费者和企业采用决策产生异质性；3）从传统支付转向即时支付的意外性（准自然实验）。
AI.findings: 1）Pix显著增加银行存款（金融包容性和货币流通加快）；2）提高地方存款波动性（资金跨机构重新分配加快）；3）降低全国银行层面存款波动性（地理分散化收益）。通过2025年虚假新闻事件的临时冲击验证了这些发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统分析即时支付系统对存款动态的影响；2）揭示金融技术创新如何改变银行资金结构；3）提供支付系统改革影响金融稳定的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为中央银行设计支付系统提供政策启示；2）帮助银行管理存款波动性风险；3）为金融监管机构评估支付创新影响提供实证依据。

title: Impact of Environmental Measures on International Trade (with focus on EU CBAM & WTO law)
affiliations: Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Management Studies

detail.title: Impact of Environmental Measures on International Trade (with focus on EU CBAM & WTO law)
detail.abstract:
The increasing integration of environmental concerns into international trade policy has given rise to complex legal challenges within the framework of the World Trade Organization (WTO). One such development is the European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), which seeks to address carbon leakage by imposing a carbon cost on certain imported goods. While the measure aims to promote climate objectives and ensure a level playing field between domestic and foreign producers, it raises significant questions regarding its compatibility with established WTO principles, particularly those of non-discrimination under the Most Favoured Nation and National Treatment obligations.

This paper examines the legal and policy implications of CBAM within the WTO framework, analysing whether it constitutes a legitimate environmental measure or a disguised restriction on international trade. It further explores the scope of justification under Article XX of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), with reference to relevant WTO jurisprudence. The study also considers the perspective of developing countries, particularly India, highlighting concerns relating to equity, compliance burdens, and trade competitiveness.

The paper argues that while CBAM may be justified in principle as an environmental measure, its legality ultimately depends on its design and implementation. A balanced and context-sensitive approach is necessary to reconcile trade liberalisation with climate objectives, ensuring that environmental measures do not undermine the foundational principles of fairness and non-discrimination in international trade law.

AI.tldr: 本文分析欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）在WTO框架下的法律与政策影响，探讨其作为环境措施的合法性，以及与发展中国家（特别是印度）相关的公平性、合规负担和贸易竞争力问题。
AI.research_question: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）是否符合WTO法律框架？它是否构成合法的环境措施还是变相的贸易限制？
AI.motivation: 随着环境关切日益融入国际贸易政策，WTO框架内出现了复杂的法律挑战。CBAM旨在解决碳泄漏问题，但对WTO非歧视原则（最惠国待遇和国民待遇）的兼容性存在重大疑问。
AI.theoretical_framework: WTO法律框架，特别是GATT第20条（一般例外条款）及相关WTO判例；非歧视原则（最惠国待遇和国民待遇）；国际贸易法与环境保护的平衡理论。
AI.method: 法律与政策分析；WTO规则与判例研究；发展中国家（特别是印度）视角的考量；CBAM设计与实施的法律评估。
AI.findings: CBAM原则上可作为环境措施被正当化，但其合法性最终取决于具体设计与实施。需要在贸易自由化与气候目标之间找到平衡，确保环境措施不损害国际贸易法中公平与非歧视的基本原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对WTO框架下环境贸易措施合法性的理解；为GATT第20条在碳定价机制中的应用提供分析框架；探讨国际贸易法与气候变化政策的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计符合WTO规则的碳边境调节机制提供指导；帮助发展中国家（特别是印度）应对CBAM带来的挑战；促进国际贸易体系与气候目标的协调。

title: The Bifurcation Index (BFX): A Composite Indicator of Distributional Economic Divergence

detail.title: The Bifurcation Index (BFX): A Composite Indicator of Distributional Economic Divergence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Bifurcation Analytics and creator of the Bifurcation Index. The index is a proprietary product of Bifurcation Analytics. No external funding was received. All data are sourced from publicly available U.S. government repositories.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data sources are free and publicly available via the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) API.

detail.abstract: The Bifurcation Index (BFX) is a proprietary composite economic indicator that quantifies the structural divergence between upper-income and lower-income economic realities in the United States. The index synthesizes 15 analytical components derived from 33 FRED data series across five equally-weighted pillars — Consumer Spending, Labor Market, Housing, Financial Assets, and Consumer Sentiment — into a single interpretable score from 0 to 100. A reading of 50 represents the pre-pandemic baseline established over the January 2008 – December 2019 reference period. All component series are stationary by design: ratios, YoY growth rates, bounded rates, or detrended via ratio to a 120-month trailing moving average. A single five-step pipeline applies a 3-month centered moving average followed by fixed-baseline z-scoring to convert each component to a 0–100 scale. Published BFX values are the direct equal-weighted average of the five pillar scores — final on the date of publication with no composite-level smoothing. At publication, the BFX reads 57 (Slightly Above Baseline), with pillar scores of: Consumer Spending 81, Labor Market 39, Housing 50, Financial Assets 55, Consumer Sentiment 61. Empirical validation on the constructed backtest demonstrates statistically significant leading relationships with consumer sector relative performance, credit card delinquency trends, sector return dispersion, and consumer sentiment — all in the expected direction. The 2008–2026 historical series is a constructed backtest; live publication commenced March 2026.

AI.tldr: BFX指数是一个衡量美国高收入和低收入群体经济现实结构分化的专有复合指标，由15个分析组件组成，涵盖消费支出、劳动力市场、住房、金融资产和消费者情绪五大支柱，采用0-100评分体系，57分表示略高于疫情前基线水平。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够量化美国高收入和低收入群体经济现实结构分化的复合经济指标？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个系统性的指标来捕捉和衡量美国经济中日益加剧的收入分化现象，为政策制定者、投资者和研究人员提供量化工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济分化理论、收入不平等研究框架，以及复合指标构建方法论，通过多维度数据整合来反映结构性经济差异。
AI.method: 采用五支柱框架（消费支出、劳动力市场、住房、金融资产、消费者情绪），从33个FRED数据系列中提取15个分析组件，通过五步数据处理管道（包括3个月中心移动平均和固定基线z-score转换）构建0-100评分体系。
AI.findings: BFX指数当前读数为57（略高于基线），各支柱得分分别为：消费支出81、劳动力市场39、住房50、金融资产55、消费者情绪61。实证验证显示该指数与消费者部门相对表现、信用卡违约趋势、部门回报分散度和消费者情绪存在统计显著的领先关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统化的经济分化量化框架，将多维经济数据整合为单一可解释指标，为收入不平等研究提供了新的测量工具和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监测经济分化的实时工具，帮助投资者识别市场机会和风险，为研究人员提供了可回溯的历史数据系列（2008-2026），支持经济分化趋势分析。

title: Entry, Allocation, and Welfare in Successive Oligopoly
affiliations: Lancaster University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Entry, Allocation, and Welfare in Successive Oligopoly
detail.abstract: We study a successive oligopoly with free entry at both stages of production and find two sources of inefficiency: a misallocation of firms across stages and an inefficient level of total entry.  The direction of misallocation depends on  the curvature of inverse demand for the final good. Whether entry is excessive or insufficient depends on how misallocation affects industry profit and on a business-stealing externality based on average industry output.

AI.tldr: 研究两阶段生产中的连续寡头垄断与自由进入，发现两种效率损失来源：企业跨阶段配置不当和总进入水平无效。配置不当方向取决于最终产品逆需求函数的曲率，进入过度或不足取决于配置不当如何影响行业利润以及基于行业平均产出的商业窃取外部性。
AI.research_question: 在两阶段生产连续寡头垄断的自由进入市场中，存在哪些效率损失来源？企业跨阶段配置不当的方向由什么决定？总进入水平过度或不足取决于哪些因素？
AI.motivation: 理解垂直生产结构中的市场效率问题，特别是当两个生产阶段都存在自由进入时，分析市场均衡与最优配置之间的差异，为产业组织理论提供新的见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续寡头垄断理论、自由进入均衡、垂直生产结构、外部性理论（商业窃取外部性）、产业组织理论中的效率分析。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建两阶段生产连续寡头垄断模型，假设两个生产阶段都存在自由进入，分析市场均衡条件与社会最优条件，比较两者差异。
AI.findings: 发现两种效率损失来源：1）企业跨阶段配置不当，其方向取决于最终产品逆需求函数的曲率；2）总进入水平无效（可能过度或不足），这取决于配置不当如何影响行业利润以及基于行业平均产出的商业窃取外部性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了垂直生产结构中的效率分析，识别了连续寡头垄断中两种新的效率损失机制，建立了企业跨阶段配置与总进入水平之间的理论联系，丰富了产业组织理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供分析垂直产业结构效率的框架，帮助识别市场失灵的具体形式，为产业政策设计提供理论依据，特别是在涉及多阶段生产的行业中。

title: Exploring Macro-Constitutional Reality in Ukraine: Multi-Textual Insights from the Constitutional Court

detail.title: Exploring Macro-Constitutional Reality in Ukraine: Multi-Textual Insights from the Constitutional Court
detail.abstract: This chapter offers a deep and comprehensive analysis of Ukraine's constitutional framework by examining the applicability of the multi-textual constitution phenomenon to the national constitution. Although the 1996 Constitution of Ukraine is traditionally regarded as a single codified act, at least three additional documents can co-share some characteristics of the country's supreme law. These documents include, inter alia, (1) the Act of Declaration of Independence of Ukraine, approved by a referendum on 1 December 1991, (2) the Law of Ukraine 'On Adoption of the Constitution of Ukraine and Its Entry into Force' adopted immediately after the Constitution, and (3) the Rules of Procedure of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine, which, although technically a piece of ordinary legislation, has become a part of constitutional interpretation due to the Constitutional Court's activism. This research relies on normative analysis of relevant legal instruments and the case law of the Constitutional Court of Ukraine as key sources for understanding how the Constitution of Ukraine operates. The chapter demonstrates that the multi-textual constitution theory is not merely an intellectual construct but also possesses practical applicability, particularly in the case of Ukraine, where it contributes to the emergence of a 'macro-constitutional reality'.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨乌克兰宪法框架，分析多文本宪法现象在乌克兰的适用性，指出除了1996年宪法外，至少还有三个文件具有宪法性特征，共同构成乌克兰的"宏观宪法现实"。
AI.research_question: 多文本宪法理论是否适用于乌克兰宪法框架？乌克兰是否存在多文本宪法现象？
AI.motivation: 虽然1996年乌克兰宪法传统上被视为单一法典化法案，但实际上存在多个具有宪法特征的文件，需要系统分析这些文件如何共同构成乌克兰的宪法框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多文本宪法理论，该理论认为一个国家的宪法可能由多个文本共同构成，而不仅仅是单一法典化文件。
AI.method: 规范性分析相关法律文书和乌克兰宪法法院的判例法，作为理解乌克兰宪法运作的关键来源。
AI.findings: 乌克兰存在多文本宪法现象，至少有三个额外文件具有宪法特征：(1)1991年12月1日公投批准的《乌克兰独立宣言法》；(2)宪法通过后立即通过的《关于通过乌克兰宪法及其生效的法律》；(3)《乌克兰最高拉达议事规则》。这些文件与1996年宪法共同构成乌克兰的"宏观宪法现实"。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多文本宪法理论不仅是一个理论建构，而且具有实际适用性，特别是在乌克兰这样的案例中，该理论有助于解释宪法框架的实际运作。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解乌克兰宪法体系提供了更全面的视角，揭示了宪法解释和实践中的复杂性，对法律实践者和政策制定者具有实际指导意义。

title: Firm Hierarchies and Misallocation
affiliations: Duke University and Duke University

detail.title: Firm Hierarchies and Misallocation
detail.abstract: We study how internal hierarchies affect productivity, wages, and labor shares in Chinese manufacturing firms. Using detailed information on professional titles from the 2004 Annual Survey of Industrial Production, we construct firm-level measures of hierarchical structure and compare private firms with state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Private firms operate leaner hierarchies and exhibit rising labor productivity as organizational layers expand. In contrast, SOEs adopt prematurely deep and top-heavy hierarchies associated with declining labor productivity but higher wages. As a result, labor shares are substantially higher in SOEs. Counterfactual exercises show that distortions in hiring and organizational design account for a large fraction of the labor share gap between SOEs and private firms, pointing to inefficient internal organization as an important source of aggregate misallocation.

AI.tldr: 研究中国制造业企业内部层级结构对生产率、工资和劳动份额的影响，发现私营企业采用精简层级结构且随组织层级扩张生产率上升，而国有企业采用过早深化、头重脚轻的层级结构导致生产率下降但工资更高，造成劳动份额差异
AI.research_question: 企业内部层级如何影响生产率、工资和劳动份额？国有企业和私营企业在层级结构上有什么差异？这些差异如何解释两者在劳动份额上的差距？
AI.motivation: 理解中国制造业企业内部的层级结构差异及其对经济绩效的影响，特别是国有企业和私营企业在组织设计上的不同如何导致劳动份额差异，这有助于解释资源配置效率问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织经济学、企业内部层级理论、资源配置理论、国有企业和私营企业比较分析框架
AI.method: 使用2004年工业年度调查数据中的专业职称信息构建企业层级结构指标，比较国有企业和私营企业，进行反事实分析
AI.findings: 1. 私营企业采用精简层级结构，组织层级扩张时劳动生产率上升；2. 国有企业采用过早深化、头重脚轻的层级结构，导致劳动生产率下降但工资更高；3. 国有企业劳动份额显著高于私营企业；4. 招聘和组织设计扭曲解释了大部分劳动份额差距
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了企业内部层级结构对经济绩效影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了国有企业和私营企业在组织设计上的系统性差异；3. 将企业内部组织效率与宏观资源配置联系起来
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国有企业改革提供组织设计方面的政策建议；2. 帮助企业优化内部层级结构提高效率；3. 为理解中国制造业资源配置效率提供微观基础

title: Research on Reliability Prediction of Fatigue Failure of Fast Mechanical Switch Insulation Rod Based on Voltage Quantization Characterization
affiliations: Anhui University, Anhui University, Anhui University, Anhui University and Anhui University

detail.title: Research on Reliability Prediction of Fatigue Failure of Fast Mechanical Switch Insulation Rod Based on Voltage Quantization Characterization
detail.abstract: This study addresses the challenges of accurately predicting the lifespan of insulation rods in fast mechanical switches under time-varying stress, including difficulties in on-site stress measurement and the lack of life dispersion characterization. We propose a fatigue reliability prediction method that combines direct voltage quantization with the inverse power law and Weibull distribution. To validate our COMSOL simulation model, we established a multi-voltage condition test platform. Using the damage equivalence principle, we extracted equivalent stress and developed a linear voltage-equivalent stress relationship. This led to the formulation of a direct voltage-life quantization equation through a dedicated inverse power law model. By integrating the Weibull distribution, we constructed a combined model that facilitates rapid life calculations without on-site stress testing. We introduced a progressive evaluation process that merges a deterministic loss account with a probabilistic reliability model. The model's generality was confirmed through tests under un-simulated working conditions, and it was applied to engineering tasks such as multi-condition life prediction, voltage fluctuation quantification, and extreme condition assessment. Results demonstrated that the combined model offers low prediction error and high efficiency, effectively quantifying allowable voltage fluctuation ranges. Safety assessments under extreme conditions were achieved via model extrapolation. This method effectively addresses the challenges of stress measurement and slow evaluation in on-site operations, offering an efficient and scalable solution for the reliable design and precise operation of insulation rods.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合直接电压量化、逆幂律和威布尔分布的绝缘棒疲劳可靠性预测方法，解决了现场应力测量困难和寿命分散性表征缺失的问题，实现了无需现场应力测试的快速寿命计算。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测快速机械开关中绝缘棒在时变应力下的寿命，特别是在现场应力测量困难和缺乏寿命分散性表征的情况下？
AI.motivation: 绝缘棒在快速机械开关中的寿命预测面临两大挑战：1）现场应力测量困难；2）缺乏寿命分散性表征。这些问题导致现场操作中应力测量困难、评估速度慢，影响绝缘棒的可靠设计和精确操作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）损伤等效原理；2）逆幂律模型；3）威布尔分布；4）电压-等效应力线性关系；5）直接电压-寿命量化方程
AI.method: 1）建立多电压条件测试平台验证COMSOL仿真模型；2）利用损伤等效原理提取等效应力；3）建立电压-等效应力线性关系；4）通过专用逆幂律模型制定直接电压-寿命量化方程；5）结合威布尔分布构建组合模型；6）提出融合确定性损失账户和概率可靠性模型的渐进评估流程
AI.findings: 1）组合模型具有低预测误差和高效率；2）能够有效量化允许电压波动范围；3）通过模型外推实现极端条件下的安全评估；4）在未模拟工况下的测试验证了模型的通用性；5）成功应用于多条件寿命预测、电压波动量化和极端条件评估等工程任务
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了结合直接电压量化、逆幂律和威布尔分布的疲劳可靠性预测理论框架；2）建立了电压-等效应力的线性关系模型；3）开发了直接电压-寿命量化方程；4）构建了融合确定性损失账户和概率可靠性模型的渐进评估理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1）实现了无需现场应力测试的快速寿命计算；2）为绝缘棒的可靠设计和精确操作提供了高效可扩展的解决方案；3）能够量化允许电压波动范围；4）支持极端条件下的安全评估；5）解决了现场操作中应力测量困难和评估速度慢的实际问题

title: Regime-Aware Allocation for Robust Multi-Asset Portfolio Management
affiliations: Princeton University - Department of Operations Research & Financial Engineering (ORFE) and

detail.title: Regime-Aware Allocation for Robust Multi-Asset Portfolio Management
detail.abstract: We develop a regime-based asset allocation framework for multi-asset portfolios that adapts exposures to evolving asset-level regimes, aiming to enhance long-term performance over passive benchmarks while limiting drawdowns and improving crisis resilience. The framework combines statistical jump models, which infer persistent latent bull and bear regimes from historical returns, with a supervised learning model that forecasts future regime transitions. Regime forecasts are integrated into standard allocation rules, including equal-weight and risk-parity, to demonstrate how regime awareness strengthens widely used strategies. Portfolio construction is further extended by testing gold as a fallback asset when all risky assets are bearish, reflecting its renewed appeal as a safe-haven amid recent market uncertainty. The framework is applied to U.S. equity, bond, and currency indices over the 1992-2025 period. Regime filters provide downside protection in equities, volatility reduction in bonds, and improved asymmetry in currencies, while their aggregation into portfolios yields higher Sharpe and Sortino ratios, smaller drawdowns, and resilience across major crises. Robustness checks confirm that these results are not dependent on auxiliary macro or sentiment features.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于体制的资产配置框架，通过适应资产层面的体制变化来增强多资产组合的长期表现，同时限制回撤并提高危机韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够适应资产层面体制变化的多资产配置框架，以在长期超越被动基准的同时限制回撤并提高危机韧性？
AI.motivation: 传统资产配置策略往往忽视资产层面的体制变化（牛市/熊市），导致在市场转折点时表现不佳。需要开发一个能够动态适应体制变化的框架，以增强投资组合的长期表现和危机韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 体制转换理论：资产收益存在持续的潜在牛市和熊市体制；2. 统计跳跃模型：从历史收益推断潜在体制；3. 监督学习模型：预测未来体制转换；4. 资产配置理论：包括等权重和风险平价等标准配置规则。
AI.method: 结合统计跳跃模型（推断历史收益中的潜在体制）和监督学习模型（预测未来体制转换），将体制预测整合到标准资产配置规则中。测试黄金作为所有风险资产处于熊市时的避险资产。应用美国股票、债券和货币指数（1992-2025年）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 体制过滤器在股票中提供下行保护，在债券中降低波动性，在货币中改善不对称性。将这些过滤器聚合到投资组合中，产生更高的夏普比率和索提诺比率、更小的回撤，并在主要危机中表现出韧性。稳健性检验证实结果不依赖于辅助的宏观或情绪特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了一个统一的体制感知资产配置框架；2. 将统计跳跃模型与监督学习模型相结合进行体制预测；3. 展示了体制意识如何增强广泛使用的投资策略；4. 提出了黄金作为系统性避险资产的扩展应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了实用的体制感知资产配置工具；2. 展示了如何在标准配置规则中整合体制预测；3. 提供了危机时期的下行保护和韧性增强策略；4. 验证了黄金作为避险资产的有效性；5. 开发了不依赖复杂宏观预测的稳健框架。

title: Rates Up, Balances Up: Uneven Monetary Transmission in Consumer Credit Markets
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Gies College of Business, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Gies College of Business, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Gies College of Business and UIUC

detail.title: Rates Up, Balances Up: Uneven Monetary Transmission in Consumer Credit Markets
detail.abstract: What happens to consumer borrowing when interest rates rise? Using a representative panel of consumer credit records and individual-level local projections, we show that contractionary monetary policy increases rather than reduces household debt. A 1 s.d. contractionary shock raises total debt by $3,967, or 7%, over three years. On the extensive margin, the number of credit accounts also increases in response to a contractionary shock. The effect is stronger and more persistent for financially constrained consumers. Mechanism evidence is consistent with an indirect channel: tighter policy weakens labor markets and household income, increasing reliance on credit among exposed borrowers. Our findings highlight an important distributional dimension of monetary transmission, as tightening raises indebtedness among vulnerable households.

AI.tldr: 紧缩性货币政策反而会增加而非减少家庭债务，特别是对财务约束较强的消费者影响更大更持久，这主要通过间接渠道实现：紧缩政策削弱劳动力市场和家庭收入，使受影响的借款人更依赖信贷。
AI.research_question: 当利率上升时，消费者借贷会发生什么变化？紧缩性货币政策如何影响家庭债务水平？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为紧缩性货币政策会减少借贷，但本文通过实证研究挑战这一观点，探讨货币政策对家庭债务的实际影响及其分布效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论，特别是通过劳动力市场和收入渠道对家庭债务的间接影响；金融约束理论，关注不同财务约束程度的消费者对货币政策反应的异质性。
AI.method: 使用代表性消费者信用记录面板数据，采用个体层面的局部投影法（local projections）分析货币政策冲击对家庭债务的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 紧缩性货币政策反而增加家庭债务：1个标准差紧缩冲击使总债务在三年内增加3,967美元（7%）；2. 信贷账户数量也增加；3. 对财务约束较强的消费者影响更大更持久；4. 机制证据支持间接渠道：紧缩政策削弱劳动力市场和家庭收入，增加受影响借款人对信贷的依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战传统货币政策传导理论，揭示紧缩政策可能增加而非减少家庭债务；2. 提出并验证货币政策通过劳动力市场和收入渠道影响家庭债务的间接机制；3. 强调货币政策传导的分布维度，揭示对脆弱家庭的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供重要启示：紧缩性货币政策可能意外增加脆弱家庭的债务负担；2. 帮助金融机构理解不同消费者群体对货币政策反应差异；3. 为消费者保护政策提供依据，关注货币政策对弱势群体的分布效应。

title: Research on the Life Assessment of the Insulating Rod of a Fast Mechanical Switch Based on the Weibull Distribution and the Firefly Algorithm
affiliations: Department of Preventive Medicine, School of Health Sciences, Wuhan University, Anhui University and Anhui University

detail.title: Research on the Life Assessment of the Insulating Rod of a Fast Mechanical Switch Based on the Weibull Distribution and the Firefly Algorithm
detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of increasingly stringent reliability requirements for fast mechanical switches in power systems, the life assessment of the insulating rod, a core component of fast mechanical switches, faces the challenges of insufficient credibility in pure simulation, high costs in pure testing, and limited coverage of operating conditions. To address this, this study proposes a method for predicting the life of insulating rods based on the three-parameter Weibull distribution and the firefly optimization algorithm, enabling reliable assessment of the rod life under multiple driving voltage conditions. First, a multi-physical coupling finite element model of the switch is established, and the validity of the model is verified through actual stress tests. Second, the failure life is calculated by combining the stress-life curve and the linear cumulative damage theory. Subsequently, the three-parameter Weibull distribution is used to fit the data, the parameters are globally optimized via the firefly algorithm, and the statistical characteristic indicators are derived in combination with the gamma function. The experimental verification and simulation expansion methods adopted in this study avoid the drawbacks of pure testing and pure simulation, providing a theoretical and engineering foundation for the reliability design and life assessment of key components of high-end equipment.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于三参数威布尔分布和萤火虫优化算法的绝缘拉杆寿命预测方法，解决纯仿真可信度不足、纯测试成本高、工况覆盖有限的问题，为高端装备关键部件可靠性设计提供理论工程基础。
AI.research_question: 如何在多驱动电压工况下，建立可靠且经济的绝缘拉杆寿命评估方法？
AI.motivation: 电力系统对快速机械开关可靠性要求日益严格，绝缘拉杆作为核心部件，其寿命评估面临纯仿真可信度不足、纯测试成本高、工况覆盖有限的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三参数威布尔分布、萤火虫优化算法、应力-寿命曲线、线性累积损伤理论、多物理场耦合有限元模型。
AI.method: 1) 建立开关多物理场耦合有限元模型并通过实际应力测试验证；2) 结合应力-寿命曲线和线性累积损伤理论计算失效寿命；3) 用三参数威布尔分布拟合数据，萤火虫算法全局优化参数；4) 结合伽马函数推导统计特征指标。
AI.findings: 提出的方法避免了纯测试和纯仿真的缺点，实现了多驱动电压工况下绝缘拉杆寿命的可靠评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将三参数威布尔分布与萤火虫优化算法结合用于寿命预测；2) 建立了多物理场耦合模型与统计方法的融合框架；3) 提供了基于伽马函数的统计特征指标推导方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为快速机械开关绝缘拉杆的可靠性设计提供工程基础；2) 降低了寿命评估成本同时提高了可信度；3) 为高端装备关键部件的寿命评估提供了可借鉴的方法。

title: From Prenatal Fantasy to Collective Life: The Relational Architecture of Existence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Prenatal Fantasy to Collective Life: The Relational Architecture of Existence
detail.abstract: The beginning of human life shows that existence appears as an event of relationship. Even before conception occurs, the future child is often already situated within a field of desire, fantasy, and expectation belonging to others. Human existence emerges within a symbolic space where others have already thought of it or desired it. The birth of the human being therefore begins within a network of relationships, within which existence gradually acquires form. Biological Conception as a Primary Relational Event Biological conception itself already constitutes a relational event. Human life arises from the union of two cells that combine to create a new organism. From that moment onward, the organism itself is formed through cooperative processes among cells that differentiate, communicate, and coordinate in order to create tissues and organs. The heart, the brain, and all the systems of the body are products of this organized cellular articulation. Life, from its most elementary biological level to its most complex form of organization, emerges through processes of connection and cooperation.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为人类生命从最初就具有关系性本质，生命始于关系网络中的存在，生物受孕本身已是关系事件，生命从细胞层面到复杂组织都通过连接与合作过程产生。
AI.research_question: 人类生命如何从最初就具有关系性本质？生物受孕和生命形成过程如何体现关系性特征？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统将人类生命视为孤立个体的观点，强调生命从最初就存在于关系网络中，受孕前就处于他人的欲望、幻想和期待场域中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系存在论、符号互动理论、生物学中的合作与连接理论、精神分析中的欲望与幻想理论。
AI.method: 理论分析、概念论证、生物学现象观察、哲学思辨。
AI.findings: 1. 人类存在在受孕前就已处于他人的象征空间中；2. 生物受孕本身是关系事件；3. 生命从细胞分化到器官形成都基于细胞间的合作与协调；4. 生命从最基本到最复杂层面都通过连接与合作过程产生。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出关系性生命起源理论；2. 挑战个体主义生命观；3. 建立生物学过程与关系性存在的联系；4. 发展符号空间中的生命存在理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解人类发展提供关系性视角；2. 对生殖医学和生命伦理有启示；3. 对心理治疗和人际关系理论有应用价值；4. 促进对生命本质的更全面理解。

title: Age-Sets and Gadaa-grades

detail.title: Age-Sets and Gadaa-grades
detail.abstract: This chapter examines the structural foundations of the Gadaa System by distinguishing and interrelating age-sets and Gadaa-grades as two core yet analytically distinct institutions. It explains that age-sets are universal eight-year biological cohorts organising the Oromo life cycle into developmental, mature, and retirement phases, while Gadaa-grades are genealogical-generation–based political stages through which members of a Gadaa party progress toward leadership (Luba) and subsequently retire through descending grades. The chapter clarifies that although the two systems ideally align for “right-born” sons—those born during the father’s designated dhaloota period—they are structurally independent, and misalignment is common. It further elaborates the forty-year generational separation between fathers and sons, the five-party succession system, and the principle of staggered power transfer, demonstrating how ritual timing, passage rites, military training, property rights, leadership formation, and civic responsibilities are integrated into a coherent socio-political order. By separating biological age from political progression, the chapter resolves terminological confusion and presents the Gadaa System as a complex, adaptive institution grounded in cyclical time, generational balance, and structured civic development.

AI.tldr: 该章节区分并关联了年龄组和Gadaa等级这两个核心但分析上不同的制度，阐明了Gadaa系统的结构基础。年龄组是基于生物年龄的八年队列，而Gadaa等级是基于代际的政治阶段，两者结构独立但理想情况下对齐。
AI.research_question: Gadaa系统的结构基础是什么？年龄组和Gadaa等级这两个核心制度如何区分和关联？
AI.motivation: 澄清Gadaa系统中术语的混淆，理解这一复杂社会政治秩序的结构基础，分析生物年龄与政治进步之间的分离与关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会制度分析、代际理论、生命周期理论、政治发展阶段理论、结构功能主义
AI.method: 概念分析、结构分析、制度分析、比较分析（基于奥罗莫族Gadaa系统的民族志资料）
AI.findings: 1. 年龄组是八年生物队列，组织生命周期为发展、成熟和退休阶段；2. Gadaa等级是基于代际的政治阶段，成员通过政党向领导层(Luba)进步；3. 两个系统结构独立，对齐仅发生在"正生"儿子中；4. 父子间有四十年代际间隔；5. 五党继承系统和交错权力转移原则；6. 仪式时间、通过仪式、军事训练、财产权、领导力形成和公民责任整合为连贯的社会政治秩序。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了Gadaa系统中年龄组和Gadaa等级的概念区分；2. 提出了生物年龄与政治进步分离的分析框架；3. 展示了循环时间、代际平衡和结构化公民发展如何构成复杂适应制度的基础；4. 解决了术语混淆问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解奥罗莫族社会政治组织提供清晰框架；2. 有助于跨文化比较研究；3. 为研究传统治理系统提供分析工具；4. 对理解代际权力转移和社会稳定机制有实践意义。
